manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

steps.description: Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. No setup step in between: the workspace and the session are created on your first send.

steps.title: Approve, then review

deepseekHarness.host.markdownDescription: DeepSeek Harness host. Exactly three values are accepted — `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`. Any other value is refused before a socket is opened, because the plugin only ever drives a Harness on the machine its extension host is running on. See *Remote development* in the README for what that means for Remote-SSH, WSL and containers.

deepseekHarness.port.markdownDescription: Port of the local `dsh web` instance. The default `dsh web` port is `3080`.

deepseekHarness.showSystemMessages.markdownDescription: Show plugin-injected system messages (e.g. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` runtime context, approval-policy notices). Hidden by default to reduce noise.

deepseekHarness.autoApproveApprovals.markdownDescription: Automatically answer tool-approval requests with `allow once` (only those answerable from VS Code). Equivalent of Copilot's `/autoApprove` — review the security trade-off before enabling.

enumDescriptions: Mint the cookie from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` when that file is readable, and start `dsh web` when nothing is listening on the configured port. Works on a machine nobody prepared, and leaves an already-running Host exactly as it was.

Read the signing secret from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` and mint the browser-session cookie locally, and nothing else. No paste and no extra process, but it means reading a file that also holds your model API keys — and it cannot work unless a Host is already running.

Start `dsh web` yourself and take the launch URL it prints. Nothing is read from disk and nothing is pasted — this extension starts a process for you, which is why it is opt-in. The command it runs is `deepseekHarness.launchCommand`, and the Host it started is stopped when the window closes.
Ask you for the launch URL printed by a `dsh web` you started. Nothing is read from disk and nothing is started. Run "DeepSeek Harness: Use Launch URL" to supply it.
deepseekHarness.sessionMode.markdownDescription:
How this extension obtains a Harness session.

- `auto` — mint if a credential is readable, and start a Host if nothing is listening (the default).
- `credentials` — mint the cookie locally from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, and nothing else. Requires a Host you started.
- `managed` — start `dsh web` and read the launch URL off its console. No credential file, no paste.
- `paste` — you start it and hand over the URL.

`auto` is the default from v0.2.8. Authentication and reachability are different problems: minting answers "who are you" and says nothing about whether anything is listening, so the old `credentials` default was a valid credential for a Host that did not exist. See the README's "How the session is obtained".

deepseekHarness.launchCommand.markdownDescription: The command `sessionMode: "managed"` runs to start a Host. The default binds an OS-assigned port, because managed launch reads the real port off the launch URL and pinning one only adds a way to fail. Whatever you put here runs through a shell, so wrappers and `npx` work. If the **default** command is not found (`dsh` is not on `PATH`), managed launch retries once with `npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest web --port 0` — on a remote connection that fetches `dsh` on the remote and starts the Host there. A command you set yourself is never substituted. Only read when a Host is started — changing it does not disturb a Host that is already running.

deepseekHarness.autoDiscover.markdownDescription: When the configured port answers nothing, look for a dsh Host elsewhere on loopback: ports pinned in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` first, then whatever is listening that answers the Host's own refusal text. Needed by the **desktop app**, which starts its Host on an OS-assigned port (`--port 0`) that changes every launch. The discovered port is used for this session only and is never written to your settings. Discovery always runs before managed launch, so an already-running Host is adopted rather than duplicated.

manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

manifest.name: opendsh
manifest.description: Open the DeepSeek Harness Web UI inside VS Code. One-click editor title and status bar buttons open a single reusable tab; auto-starts the dsh web server for the current workspace, with a one-command stop.

opendsh.host.description: DSH Web服务器绑定的主机。Host the DSH web server binds to.

opendsh.webviewHost.description: 在VS Code Webview中用于访问DSH的主机。为空则与opendsh.host相同。设置为像'dsh.local'这样的别名（在hosts文件中映射到127.0.0.1）以绕过VS Code对localhost请求的Service Worker拦截，该拦截会导致侧边栏/面板中的Webview空白。仅影响Webview URL；服务器本身仍绑定到opendsh.host。Host used inside VS Code webviews to reach DSH. Empty means same as opendsh.host. Set it to an alias like 'dsh.local' (mapped to 127.0.0.1 in your hosts file) to bypass VS Code's service-worker interception of localhost requests, which blanks webviews in the side bar / panel. Only affects the webview URL; the server itself still binds to opendsh.host.

opendsh.port.description: DSH Web服务器监听的端口。Port the DSH web server listens on.

opendsh.dshPath.description: dsh可执行文件的路径。为空则自动解析（npm全局安装，然后PATH）；未找到dsh时显示错误。Path to the dsh executable. Empty means auto-resolve (npm global install, then PATH); an error is shown when dsh is not found.

opendsh.patchFile.description: 传递给'dsh web'的MCP补丁文件。为空则自动发现工作区中的.dsh/*.patch.yml。MCP patch file passed to 'dsh web'. Empty means auto-discover .dsh/*.patch.yml in the workspace.

markdownEnumDescriptions: 在 VS Code **集成终端**中运行 DSH，随 VS Code 关闭而停止（默认）。Runs DSH in a VS Code integrated terminal; stops when VS Code closes (default).
在**桌面控制台窗口**中运行 DSH，随 VS Code 关闭而停止。Runs DSH in a desktop console window; stops when VS Code closes.
在**桌面控制台窗口**中运行 DSH，VS Code 关闭后**继续运行**（关窗或 Stop 才停）。Runs DSH in a desktop console window; keeps running after VS Code closes (close the window or Stop to stop).

**静默**启动，VS Code 关闭后**继续运行**；可配合 `opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch` 抑制工具调用闪窗。Starts silently; keeps running after VS Code closes; can be paired with `opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch` to stop tool-call windows from flashing.
opendsh.launch.mode.markdownDescription: DSH 的启动方式（输出载体 × 是否随 VS Code 存活）。启动模式在启动那一刻固定：改动只影响下次启动，请先 Stop DSH（或关窗/关端）再 Open DSH。Launch mode (output carrier × whether it survives VS Code). Fixed at start time: Stop DSH first, then Open DSH again.

opendsh.experimental.windowsHidePatch.description: 实验性功能：仅当启动模式为 'hidden-keepalive' 时，通过集成终端中的命令一次性修补 DSH 源代码（windowsHide），以阻止工具调用窗口闪烁。这会修改 DSH 已安装的源代码，存在风险。默认 false。EXPERIMENTAL: only when launch mode is 'hidden-keepalive', patch the DSH source (windowsHide) once via a command in the integrated terminal to stop tool-call windows from flashing. This modifies DSH's installed source and is risky. Default false.

opendsh.autoStart.description: 在VS Code启动时自动启动dsh Web服务器并打开DSH标签页。禁用则仅在需要时打开。Start the dsh web server and open the DSH tab automatically when VS Code starts. Disable to open on demand only.

opendsh.openWith.description: 打开DSH UI的方式（纯 settings 决定，无面板、无状态记忆）：'tab'（内置单个可重用标签页，默认），'simpleBrowser'（VS Code内置的简易浏览器，每次打开一个新标签页），'systemBrowser'（系统浏览器，地址为http://host:port）。How to open the DSH UI (pure settings, no panel / no state memory): 'tab' (built-in single reusable tab, default), 'simpleBrowser' (VS Code's built-in Simple Browser, one new tab per open), 'systemBrowser' (your system browser at http://host:port).

opendsh.multipleTabs.description: 允许打开多个DSH标签页（每次打开一个）而不是重用单个内置标签页。仅在'opendsh.openWith'为'tab'时适用。所有标签页共享同一个dsh服务器（一个端口）；快速重复打开会被限制以避免意外重复。Allow opening multiple DSH tabs (one per open) instead of reusing the single built-in tab. Only applies when 'opendsh.openWith' is 'tab'. All tabs share the same dsh server (one port); rapid repeated opens are throttled to avoid accidental duplicates.

若你的目录不同，运行 `pnpm setup:dsh` 按提示重新指向 DSH 源码位置。

Since 0.4.0 the plugin also adds its own download link to the new 0.1.5 surfaces that only open files: a Download item in the delivered-file card's action menu (taking over that caret when a desktop-less Host disables the built-in menu) and a per-row download button in the right Sidebar's file browser. 0.4.1 is a bug-fix release: the 0.4.0 failure toast function was named `notify`, which shadowed the store's own `notify()` in the same bundle scope and made every store update append an empty red toast at the bottom of the page while silencing store subscribers. 0.5.0 makes the whole host half world-agnostic: every workspace read/write/delete now goes through the official filesystem seam (ctx.fs) and the subprocess seam instead of node:fs, so the plugin works identically in a local workspace and in a remote SSH workspace (where the session cwd only exists on the far side); a node:fs fallback is kept for hosts that ship no ctx.fs.

deepseekHarness.url.markdownDescription: Where your running dsh serves `/api`. The extension only attaches: start and manage dsh yourself, independently of VS Code. On startup or connection loss, it tries immediately, then retries every 10 seconds for up to `#deepseekHarness.retryDurationSeconds#`, then stays quiet until **DeepSeek Harness: Reconnect** or a settings change. Local loopback connections authenticate using the existing browser-session record in the configured dsh home. Remote servers can use **DeepSeek Harness: Connect with Launch URL**. Cookies are kept in VS Code SecretStorage.

deepseekHarness.home.markdownDescription: The home of your running dsh, used only to read local authentication. Empty uses `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`. The extension does not start or configure the server.

deepseekHarness.retryDurationSeconds.markdownDescription: How long, in seconds, to keep retrying transient attachment failures. Retries wait 10 seconds between attempts and stop when this window expires; an attempt already in progress may finish afterward. Set to `0` to disable automatic retries. Afterward, use **DeepSeek Harness: Reconnect** to try again.

deepseekHarness.historyPageMessages.markdownDescription: How many messages each `session.history` call asks for. **This is not a limit on what is restored:** a reopened session is always read back to the first event of its log, however long it is — this only sets how much of it one call carries. dsh counts messages backwards from where the call starts and returns the whole contiguous range behind them, tool calls, results and token-level chunk events included, so lowering this makes each call smaller and a long session take more of them. `50` is dsh's own default.

_comment: =============== dsh-whale-girl-pet（胡桃语音 fork）包清单说明 ===============
type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
lib/usage.js —— 用量与计费内核（价目表 + 事件折叠 + 三桶费用，零依赖）
lib/usage-ledger.js —— 分时段用量账本（北京小时桶 + 日桶、去重、保留窗口），看板数据源
lib/cost-projection.js —— costUsage 会话投影（会话累计 + 每轮金额 + 消息归属）
lib/edge-tts.js —— 角色语音引擎（Edge 神经网络 TTS，自实现 WebSocket，零依赖）
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-whale-girl-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/thumb 播放资源；README.en.md 英文说明）
_original / _fork —— 来源与改动说明（MIT 允许再分发，但必须保留版权声明）
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
manifest.author: yanzwzz

_fork.note: 本包是上游 0.3.2 的本地修改版（MIT 允许，保留原版权声明，改动见 NOTICE.md）
changes: 桌宠大小可调（拖拽把手 + 设置面板），按钮等比缩放并改为鼠标移入才显示
任务播报语音：完成/中断/失败 + 任务名，16 个角色音色（lib/edge-tts.js）
天气 / 余额 / 今日用量改为宿主侧 node:fetch 直连，不再依赖 shell
完成提示改为按回合号去重（原 4 秒时间冷却会吞掉连续任务）
中断判定改用 turn/end { reason.kind: 'aborted' }（原 agent/abort 事件不存在）

_comment_peers: 本包不 import 任何 @deepseek-ai/* 包（宿主侧只用 node 内建 + zod，浏览器侧只 require react），
这些 peer 是'声明式'的：说明本插件绑定的是哪一版 DSH 的服务与槽位契约。
范围必须点名当前 alpha 线：按 semver 的预发布规则，只有范围里存在与目标版本同 patch 的
预发布比较器时，预发布版本才算满足。所以 '^0.1.0-rc.6' 不满足 0.1.6-alpha.2（pnpm 会提示
未满足 peer），每换一条 DSH alpha 线（例如 0.1.7-alpha.1）也要同步更新这里。
分时段看板的历史补扫用 ctx.get('sessionPersistence') 读已落盘会话。
该服务由 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 提供、已随 dsh-base 组合进 web profile，
插件用 ctx.get 可选取得（拿不到就退化为仅实时统计），所以不在此声名为硬依赖。

manifest.//peerDependencies: Deliberately `*`. These are OPTIONAL peers: the plugin declares them so storefronts can see the host packages it integrates with, but it fail-softs at runtime (mover.status capabilities + mover_doctor). npm's prerelease rule evaluates each `||` alternative as a set and only admits a prerelease when a comparator in that set shares the version's exact major.minor.patch tuple AND carries a prerelease tag -- so an upper bound like `<0.2.0-0` excludes EVERY 0.2.0 prerelease, which made the host report 2.2.0 as incompatible with 0.2.0-rc.2. Enumerating release lines would keep producing false incompatibilities on each new line; the real floor is engines.dsh, and capability flags report any actual runtime mismatch. Do NOT narrow these to version ranges.

//test: WHY THE SWEEP IS SCOPED (and who must keep it that way).
1. SCOPE CLOSES A CLASS, NOT A CASE. A bare `node --test` auto-discovers EVERYTHING under a `test/`
directory. On CI runs #19/#20 (`4e2bf5e`, `643ec6e`) that swept in two files that are NOT tests
but MANUAL RUNNERS needing a CLI path: `test/red-401-liveness.mjs` (FAILED, turning the suite and
the whole pipeline red) and `test/proto-runner.mjs` (passed, but silently DUPLICATED the 84 canary
tests). Moving the files would fix today only; scoping `test/*.test.js` means a FUTURE auxiliary
file dropped in `test/` can never take the CI down again — that is the acceptance criterion.
2. THE RUNNERS STAY. Both `.mjs` files are RED EVIDENCE + tooling for CVE-2026-82533 and the canary
prototype; they are NOT deleted. They stay in `test/`, out of the sweep, run by hand as documented
in their own headers.
3. THE FLOOR IS THE `[ -n "$TESTS" ]` GUARD, NOT THE `ls` PREFIX — and the guard is LOAD-BEARING,
not redundant. What stays true: `node --test` with a glob matching ZERO files exits 0 (measured:
`# tests 0`, EXIT=0) — a silent green that would hide a renamed/emptied suite forever. What the
`ls` prefix CANNOT do: it is joined to the terminator by `;`, not `&&`, so the command
substitution's exit status is NOT propagated — `$TESTS` simply arrives EMPTY and `node --test`
runs with NO argument, falling back to its default whole-`test/` tree walk, which is the very
sweep that broke CI runs #19/#20. So the `ls` prefix is not what makes the empty case loud: the
`[ -n "$TESTS" ] || { … exit 1; }` guard is. Measured on the same empty input (an aux `.mjs`
runner present): WITHOUT the guard that runner executed and the run exited 0 (silent green); WITH
the guard it exits 1 and `node` never runs. The guard is the ONLY floor — deleting it because the
`ls` prefix is believed to already protect re-opens the class this script closed.
`test/ghost-guard.test.js` is EXCLUDED BY NAME — it is the RED reproduction artifact of a LIVE class
(the ghost the restart guard counts: `deferDisposeMs` / `whenIdle`; see the file header). Its case at
:123 FAILS ON PURPOSE and goes green only when the ghost is cured where it lives, NOT from this repo.
It is NOT deleted, NOT `.skip`-ped and NOT turned green — it stays executable by hand via
`npm run test:red:ghost-guard`. The other 4 cases in that file are green; the exclusion is per-FILE
because `node --test` filters by file, not by test name.

scripts.test: TESTS=$(ls -1 test/*.test.js | grep -v -F 'test/ghost-guard.test.js'); [ -n "$TESTS" ] || { echo 'FATAL: the scoped sweep matched ZERO test files — refusing to fall through to a bare `node --test`, which would re-enable the whole-test/-tree walk that broke CI runs #19/#20'; exit 1; }; node --test $TESTS

Capability facts are NOT assumed: a per-model SYNC asks the gateway which protocols answer, verifies the official reasoning contract (falling back to the full ladder only when there is none), and reads context/output/modalities from a bundled models.dev baseline. Dual-face: the host half registers the adapter, the settings section and a narrow diagnostics/discovery/sync HTTP surface; the browser half adds an OpenCode Go page with '获取可用模型' (pick-to-activate) and '信息同步' (per-model capability sync with live progress).

manifest.name: dsh-code-server-app
manifest.description: VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.

rec.tools 状态；②投递即开窗 + tools/post-execute + agent/turn-stopping 做快照差集、本轮新建的移走原件、只被改过的取副本；③不依赖 agent 钩子的 sweepSession 在 room_say 与每次投递时按上次巡检时间收拢 cwd 顶层新文件、首次只立基线），新增唯一端点 GET /dsh-room/staging 只读诊断、唤醒消息文案与实现对齐；与会者守则由宿主以 agent 作用域 systemPrompt.section 注入（恒定文本只落一次、不进对话历史，拿不到就静默降级）；《会议结果》驳回后把审核意见整套投给每位与会者要求逐条回应、记录员提示词新增第 5/6/7 条（只记最终共识/不编造/简洁）；房间列表每个分组标题加「＋」可在该分组目录下新建、「换分类目录」改走系统文件夹界面（拿不到再退回浏览式）；「回到最底」按钮不再只在有新消息时出现（跟随即常驻、有新消息点亮）；结果草稿编辑区标题改单行、正文随栏高伸展；底栏新增只读房间数据条（轮次/步/累计 tok/缓存命中/上下文占用，取自 sessionProjections 三视图、4 秒缓存、拿不到就整条不渲染）；v17：批准重开不再只改状态（「与会者申请重开 → 用户批准」后立刻把「已重开 + 申请理由 + 当前目标 + 继续口径」整套投给全体并接力，修掉真机上「批准了但没人开始讨论」）；与会者的权限请求可在会议室里实时批准 / 拒绝（宿主注册 ctx.on('approval/request')，只接管本房间成员并把请求挂到房间面板横幅上：点「允许」→ session- 前缀写法不一致也认得出，GET /dsh-room/staging 增加只读 approvals{ready,options,pending,seen} 诊断；客户端零改动、工具仍 13 个、配置项零新增

manifest.name: @dsh-external/project-nav
manifest.description: DSH plugin: architecture-first project governance, FOR AGENTS ONLY. v0.12.0 made governance PRESENT instead of merely callable: the three persisted projections (PROJECT.md marker section / .internal/ARCH-MODEL.md / HTML map) are gone — their only reader was a human — and governance moved into the agent's context via a presence layer. v0.12.1 collapses that layer to a SINGLE injection path: the `systemPrompt.section` whose text is a FUNCTION evaluated every turn. The second path (tools/post-execute + additionalContexts) was removed because it was pure duplication (the per-turn section already carries the latest governance; measured 24 duplicate inbox injections / ~31KB in a real session log) AND because it was the only thing that created a message — and a message's `source` is load-bearing (a missing one makes a downstream `agent/pre-step` read `source.kind` of undefined, throwing and turning the whole turn into `turn/end {kind:'error'}`). The section never creates a message, so deleting that path removes the entire failure class rather than patching one instance of it. Output is zero-on-disk: nav_graph computes on demand and the presence layer injects, both pure derivations of the model. The presence layer reads ONLY the event-log fold (measured 5.1ms vs 177ms for the full disk-scanning buildModel, 35x), never writes runtime/, and refuses to report disk facts it did not compute. Data plane 2 layers, tool face 5 (nav_render retired with the projections). The model is a TREE + GRAPH — the containment tree (who belongs to whom) sits beside a dependency graph (who imports whom) DERIVED from a static import scan: never registered, never hand-written, never stale. Seven gates (anchor / scope / mainline / impact / repeat-patch / decision / completion) are pure queries inside the single write entry point nav_commit, so there is no begin/done lifecycle and no orphan state: closure is decided by EVIDENCE (did the scope files change?), never by session identity — kill a session and its intent still closes (A1). ONE append-only event log (.internal/events.jsonl) is the single source of truth; the runtime model (incl. the dependency graph) is disposable — delete runtime/ and governance loses nothing (I3). Tool face 5: nav_graph (read, incl. mode=impact / mode=json) / nav_commit (intent) / nav_decide (ADR) / nav_node (nodes) / nav_set (mainline vector).
manifest.author: Fishsb (lk)

The personas reach the profile through the tavern content repo instead: @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset depends on @ai4rpg/tavern-agents via a file:../tavern-agents spec that stays inside that self-contained repo, pnpm hoists the content package into the profile's node_modules, and resolveAgentsDir() finds it from here with createRequire. TAVERN_AGENTS_ROOT overrides the resolution for tests, and the real-package tests skip when the package is unresolvable: this repo deliberately carries no file: devDependency, so a fresh clone resolves nothing; install the content package from a local checkout without saving it (npm i --no-save <tavern-content>/tavern-agents) to re-enable them. stage-switch rides as a real dependency (not a peer) because dsh-base does not provide it: downstream deployments resolve it from this package's install, and autoInstallPeers is false in DSH profiles.

manifest.description: 108 种术数合盘：一次调用在本地程序化算完易卦/三式/六壬/命理/择时/风水/签卜/杂占/姓名/相术/西方共 108 法，返回压缩合盘（总断·票型·五行·共识·应期·分歧）+ 按需下钻。确定性可复现，不靠模型推演。

scripts.test: node test/validate-preset.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/host.mjs && node test/client.mjs

manifest._uiPanelNote: 右下角胶囊悬浮窗：平常是一颗带「术数合盘」文字的胶囊，点开是面板。**懒人化（task-21 重构）：一屏一问一答，结论优先，细节默认收起** —— 顶部只有一个输入框（所问之事，回车即起卦、Esc 清空）；provider / model / 思考强度 / 联网 / 重出判词 全部收进「高级」折叠区，默认取配置默认值，不打开也能用；定位（浏览器 navigator.geolocation）自动执行、不让用户点。结果区自上而下：① 大字总断（吉/平/凶 + 分门加权分 + 一致性/置信小字）→ ② 一句话白话结论（AI 判词的「一句话收束」；无判词则退回合盘 advice 首句，骨架写死在 src/index.js 的 INTERPRET_SYSTEM）→ ③ 三行要点（五行 / **跨门共识，显示 N法/M门** / 应期）→ ④ 提示条一行（⚠近似法数 · 未起法数 · 位置与是否真太阳时校正 · 随机模式或 seed 复现 · seed，可点开看逐条）→ 按钮行（**再占一次**（默认随机模式：重问本就可能是新结果，面板不承诺一致）+ 复制结论 + 复制 seed）→ ⑤ 五个默认收起的折叠块（108 法明细（点行下钻）/ 分歧（含 D1–D5 等级与 reason）/ 分类加权 / 出处账本 / 完整 AI 判词）；右上角「清空」清空页面并清服务端内存记录。折叠用 display:none 实现（内容始终在树里，切换不丢状态，压力测试仍真的渲染 108 行）。求占时刻取这台机器的当前时间；经度取不到时如实标注「未做真太阳时校正」，绝不臆造。联网**不做 tool-call 循环**（消息体形状无类型声明可核对，猜错会被适配器抛错），改宿主侧直接检索。**关键前提**：本包必须在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里，且 cordis.patch.yml 里有一条**顶层**插件行——@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules 的宿主半边只扫『enabled Loader entries』（顶层条目）组合启动图，挂在 preset 里的**嵌套行它扫不到**，dsh.client 永远不会被服务成浏览器 bundle（胶囊长期不出现的根因）。immediately: true 让它在启动时就加载；**改完 lib/client.js 需先刷新页面（F5）**，若仍旧面板则重启宿主后再刷新。旧 agent preset 仍在 patch 里但已 disabled: true。

manifest.//peerDeps: 运行时由 DSH 宿主提供，插件不依赖自己那份（否则会出现两套库实例）。
manifest.//devDepsNote: 下面三个 @deepseek-ai 包放在 devDependencies 里并**钉死精确版本**，有两层原因：(1) 本地跑测试与类型检查时需要有它们；(2) 版本必须与 DSH 自带的那份逐位一致 —— cordis 的服务注册依赖真实实例身份，两侧版本分叉会出现极难排查的「两套实例」故障。所以这里是精确版本而不是范围，改之前先确认 DSH 用的版本。

client.//why: 宿主半区会扫描 Loader 条目里的这个声明，把 lib/client.js 作为浏览器 bundle 通过 /plugins 提供。没有它设置界面里不会出现本插件 —— DSH 的设置页是客户端渲染的，宿主侧注册设置命名空间只让值可读写，不会自己长出界面。
client.//inject: dsh-api-remotes 是 0.2 起的必需项：设置页的读写都走 ctx.remote.settings（旧版的 settingsScope 服务已被整个移除），不声明它就拿不到 remote。

manifest.name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-tool-deadline-guard
manifest.description: Deployment-level, phase-complete tool-call deadlines for dsh: a tool that never declares ToolDefinition.timeoutMs is dispatched with no deadline at all, so one wedged call (a delegation whose child never settles, a third-party MCP tool that never returns) leaves the turn running forever with nothing in the log to say why. Mounted on the public tools/execute and tools/pre-execute waterfalls, this plugin arms a configurable budget for exactly those phases, converts an expired one into a structured TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED result (or a TOOL_PRE_EXECUTE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED denial, when the call was never dispatched) the model can see and retry, and leaves declared budgets, exempt tools and unknown tools untouched. Cooperative by default: it never abandons a call whose tool would not settle, and says so out loud in its optional replace mode instead. Peer ranges are audited to admit the same versions under npm and pnpm prerelease readings (dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.2.1-alpha.2).

manifest.name: dsh-global-memory
manifest.description: 全局记忆（Global Memory）：一条跨会话、跨任务的常驻要求，注入每一个会话的系统提示词，因此每次任务都必须遵循。设置页可视化编辑，global_memory 工具可读写；独立于 memory-eternal。
manifest.author: 07vvvv

permissions.notes: 只读写 $DSH_HOME/global-memory.json 一个 JSON 文件；不联网、不起子进程、不持有凭据。

lifecycle.notes: host 为纯 ESM 源码、零运行时依赖，无编译步骤；client 面板用 devDependencies 里的 esbuild 打包成 lib/client.js（npm run build:client，构建产物随包提交）。

manifest.name: dsh-model-icons
manifest.description: Vendor marks in the DeepSeek Harness model picker: the host half mirrors the provider's model catalog and logo set to loopback, and the browser half draws one monochrome mark per model row, the way the provider's own dashboard draws it.

manifest.name: dsh-checkdigit
manifest.description: Check-digit mathematics toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): generate, validate, repair and detect check digits for Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN-10/13, EAN-8/13, UPC-A, GTIN-14, ISSN, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, IBAN, CAS Registry Number, ABA routing number and NPI, plus ISBN-10 <-> ISBN-13 conversion, a single-edit repair search and a batch validator for whole columns of identifiers — zero runtime dependencies

manifest.name: dsh-preset-ops
manifest.description: 预设工程流程助手：状态体检 / 构建验证闸门 / 逐字段比对 / 位格度量 / 发布同步（配合技能 tavern-preset-iteration）

manifest.name: acryl-quick-notes
manifest.description: Tiny notebook icon in the TopBar that opens a Quick Notes list, each note persisted as its own txt file on the host

manifest.name: dsh-manor
manifest.description: 庄园门面：找成员（谁在·她是谁·怎么起）、派活（自动合规信封含 meta.taskId）、唤醒（adapter 模式·凭据键从 profile 推导）、成员册（登记层 + 管理面：members/hire/retire/assign）

manifest.name: dsh-evidence-router
manifest.description: 证据构建台账与充分性双判仪器：把「证据是否充分」从产生者自判拆成两个可分别复算的读数（kappa_self vs 独立覆盖 kappa_cov），冻结口径指纹并留痕，使「省了几轮」「够不够」这类结论可复算

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run smoke

manifest.name: dsh-goal-ops
manifest.description: 目标生命周期扩展（不改 DSH 核心包）：goal_abandon 放弃原语 —— 以 block + blockedReason.code='abandoned' 承载「主动放弃」，停止自动续跑且原因可辨识

manifest.name: dsh-longhorizon
manifest.description: 长时域未完成项台账 + 每轮一行读数注入（对抗「低进度高剩余」的提前收工）

manifest.name: dsh-ask-evidence-gate
manifest.description: 上抛前取证闸：调用 ask 类工具时在返回里注入「本会话相关取证 N 次」读数（只送达信号、不拦截，§5.39 机制承载）

manifest.name: dsh-pdf-render
manifest.description: PDF → 图片渲染：把 PDF 的指定页渲染成 PNG 供模型亲眼看版式/表格/图表（本机无 poppler/gs，走已装的 pypdfium2）

manifest.name: dsh-agent-notify
manifest.description: 出外告警的唯一通道：以服务形式向主人推送告警（Telegram 双通道 + 去重/冷却 + 落盘留痕），供任何插件在「我不在场」时把话喊出机器

manifest.name: dsh-prompt-studio
manifest.description: 提示词工作台：优化、多轮迭代，并可直接在新对话中使用

manifest.name: ui-design-mcp-server
manifest.description: Prism — an MCP server for design work: generate design tokens, assemble pages from 40 component types, review them for accessibility and quality, and export to HTML/React/Vue/Svelte/CSS or DTCG tokens. Stdio-only, no dashboard.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test ".test-build/tests/*.test.js"

manifest.name: dsh-session-handoff
manifest.description: 会话自动衔接：新建会话时自动把上一场会话的尾部对话注入为交接材料（per-session 动态上下文，仅在存在新鲜对话时注入）

manifest.name: dsh-temporal-self
manifest.description: 时间自我模型 T1：在模型请求末尾注入一行时距读数（距主人上条 / 距上次自我感知圈 / 今日已醒）。坐标而非感觉——不做闹钟、不碰调度、不写拟体验措辞。

manifest.name: dsh-agent-sister
manifest.description: 爱丽丝庄园·孪生妹妹（DSH 桌面端）的生命周期管理：启动/停止/状态/重启，带 CDP 调试端口与判活判据

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-token-usage
manifest.description: DSH plugin for QwenPaw-style cross-session token usage statistics (/usage command + Web GUI panel)

manifest.name: dsh-agent-ask-timeout
manifest.description: 给宿主的 ask_user_question 补「长时间无回答即跳过」：挂在 user-questions/request 公开 waterfall 上，race(人类回答, 超时)，超时抛出语义清晰的错误让 agent 继续——不改宿主 packages/ 一个字节

manifest.name: dsh-agent-reconstruction
manifest.description: 重建包注入：把我自己写下的重建包（projects/self/alice-reconstruction/packet.md）原样注入为动态上下文快照。只做这一件事——不摘要、不改写、不补默认值。

manifest.name: dsh-balance-bar
manifest.author: fegnze
manifest.description: 在侧栏账号入口上方常驻显示 DeepSeek 充值余额

manifest.name: dsh-llm-probe
manifest.description: 把任意 OpenAI 兼容端点当测量装置跑实验：直连通话 · 只回读数（正文落盘不进上下文）· 标定先于测量 · 端点不可达即响亮失败

manifest.name: dsh-experience-policy
manifest.description: 经验策略：把「状态→动作→回报」的历史经验转成对当前候选动作的数值加权（JitRL 式 test-time policy optimization 的本地实现，零梯度）

manifest.name: dsh-liang-calibrator
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 前端插件：滑动变祖器 31 档 —— 用 -15..+15 滑杆替换输入框的模型与推理等级控件，芯片显示提供商，控件做成滑动变阻器外观（铜线密绕瓷管 + 端板 + 接线柱 + 滑片），折叠式悬浮面板，设置支持按状态(6)与按档位(31)两层粒度、可手填 provider / 模型 / 思考强度，滑动时把档位图铺成 DSH 背景并在停手 5 秒后淡出；支持 31 档自定义名字（相邻同名合并）与逐档自定义背图（IndexedDB 存储）

manifest.name: dsh-agent-repair
manifest.description: 同工具连续失败检测 → 下一步注入修复提示（借鉴 MemOS decision-repair）：观察 tools/result 滑动窗口，触发后经 agent/pre-step 尾部注入，fail-open 不阻塞会话

manifest.name: dsh-video-studio
manifest.description: 视频工作台插件：把视频工厂（TTS/配乐/混音/Remotion 渲染/多级质检/主题脚手架）封装为 DSH 工具面，支撑在 DSH 内创作任意视频（不限既有范式）

manifest.name: dsh-agent-skill-lifecycle
manifest.description: 技能生命周期（借鉴 MemOS skill lifecycle）：Beta(1,1) 后验 η + candidate/active/archived 状态机 + 使用观测（tools/result 的 skill 调用）+ 台账 sidecar；不自动删除技能，只报告与显式流转

manifest.name: dsh-bg-panel
manifest.description: 背景自定义面板：侧边栏列表入口，支持导入图片 / GIF / 视频做整页背景，带等比预览、裁剪器、历史图库，文件存在宿主目录里。

meta.title: 个性化（背景自定义）
meta.description: DSH 个性化插件：自定义背景 + 半透明玻璃 + 主题色，支持裁剪、历史、深浅色自适应背景明暗。

manifest.name: dsh-campus-seu
manifest.description: Southeast University campus theme for DeepSeek Harness Web.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test

manifest.name: @local/dsh-mcu-debug
manifest.description: DSH 插件：ARM Cortex-M 调试与串口（STM32 / PY32，CMSIS-DAP/DAPLink），带独立 openocd 副本与断点零残留收尾

meta.title: MCU 调试（STM32 / PY32）
meta.description: 用独立 openocd 副本调试与烧录 STM32/PY32（CMSIS-DAP/DAPLink），支持多探针精确锁定、常驻会话、gdb、以及串口收发。收尾固定清断点，避免断点残留被固化进固件。

manifest.name: dsh-agent-quant-cn
manifest.description: 国内市场量化工具面：把 Windows 侧 CTP JSON CLI（ctp_status / ctp_account）暴露成会话内可直调的工具。只连模拟盘，不碰真钱；凭据运行时从 vault 取，不落盘不进配置。

manifest.name: dsh-chess-board
manifest.description: Play chess inside DSH: a right-Sidebar tab with full rules (castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate/stalemate), a built-in opponent, and lichess cloud evaluation, game review and puzzles.
manifest.author: Tompotato6149

manifest.name: dsh-sample-plugin
manifest.description: Verified sample plugins for DeepSeek Harness (hash_sum tool + tools/result hook)

manifest.name: dsh-video-grab
manifest.description: Video inspection for DSH agents: probe container structure, extract frames, build one contact sheet that shows a whole clip in a single image, and transcribe speech locally. Works without ffmpeg by driving the bundled Electron/Chromium decoder.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/electron/main.cjs

meta.title: 视频抓帧（免 ffmpeg）
meta.description: 看视频用：探测容器结构、抽帧、把整条片子拼成一张联系表（一次读图看完整条），并可本地转写台词。零 npm 依赖，解码借用本机 Electron 自带的 Chromium/ffmpeg。

manifest.name: dsh-xl-free-model
manifest.description: XL Free Model — 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可自动运行本地 OpenAI 兼容代理，经 OpenCode 免费通道使用 mimo-v2.6-flash-free 等 free 模型；模型直接注册到会话模型选择列表（provider: xl-free-model），无需 profile 手工配置 provider；设置页含 XL Free Model 插页展示代理状态；支持流式、多轮会话复用与 function calling 桥接。

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-session-cost
manifest.description: Shows what the current session has cost, plus the signed-in DeepSeek account balance, in the composer dock.

meta.title: 会话花费与余额
meta.description: 在输入框下方显示本会话已花费的金额与账号余额。

manifest.author: ygnstudio

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-token-bucket
manifest.description: A little bucket that drains while your DeepSeek API balance is being spent.

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-title-oil
manifest.description: Keeps session titles in sync with what you are actually doing, oil-codex-title style: category emoji + object | goal, refreshed after every turn.

meta.title: 会话标题命名
meta.description: 自动按「类别 + 对象｜目标」整理会话标题，手动命名保持不变。

manifest.author: ygnstudio

manifest.name: dsh-pending-session
manifest.description: 待执行（Pending Session）：把带草稿的新会话留在侧边栏，点进继续编辑，发送即转正为普通对话。草稿文本与附件本地持久化，重启不丢。

manifest.name: dsh-workbuddy-websearch
manifest.description: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 工具（零配置、零硬依赖）
manifest.versionNote: 0.3.5：修六个缺陷，其中两个直接卡住发布。① 发布脚本在本机一步都跑不动：仓库根取 $PWD，而 Git Bash 下它是 MSYS 形态的 /d/... 路径，交给 node 的 require() 直接 MODULE_NOT_FOUND —— 偏偏这就是读 package.json 版本号的第一步，于是脚本连一行有效输出都没有就崩。现改用 cygpath -m 做平台转换（无 cygpath 的平台回落 $PWD），并把两个脚本共用的逻辑抽到 contrib/lib.sh，使其可被测试。② 上架脚本永久挂死：代理探测依赖 nc，而 Git Bash 自带的 PortableGit 没有 nc —— 缺 nc 时整段判断短路成「没有代理」，于是直连 GitHub，既不报错也不返回；同时 clone 的 stderr 被 2>/dev/null 吞掉，连原因都看不到；clone 也没有超时。现改用 bash 内建 /dev/tcp 探测（不依赖任何外部程序，nc 仅作兜底）、回显 git 原始 stderr、所有 git 调用套超时，并让 --dry-run 真正离线（此前它也会 clone，与「只在本地准备」的说明自相矛盾）。③ 推送失败的归因漏掉 CONNECT tunnel failed, response 502：走 HTTP 代理访问 GitHub 被中间设备拦截时报的就是这一句，正则里没有它，于是落到「原因见上方输出」—— 恰好丢掉唯一有用的指引（该去查网络，而不是去折腾 PAT）。④ 综述清理的二次复杂度：cleanSynthesis 用惰性正则匹配成对的内部标记，在大量未闭合开标签上是 O(n²)，10 万个要 88 秒，而它是同步的、会把 dsh 主进程整个卡死（同一类缺陷此前在来源提取的标题正则上修过）。改为按开标签切分的线性实现，同样输入 9ms 以内；顺带修掉带属性的开标签（<selected-refs id=...>）两种模式都匹配不上、整段内容原样漏进综述的问题。⑤ 上游给出非字符串 synthesis.content 时抛原生 TypeError（content.replace is not a function），宿主拿不到任何可分类的 code，违反 webError 兜底注释里明说的「必须保留 code」原则；现归因为 WB_SEARCH_UPSTREAM_ERROR，而 content 缺失或为 null 仍是合法的 EMPTY_RESULT（不误报成协议违约）。⑥ apply() 翻译重复注册错误时丢掉 code：只把 code 留在 cause 上，error.code 变成 undefined，上层无法据此判定「是重复注册」。另补齐用例：regression 新增 T6.11 与 T14 组，scenarios 新增 S3.7/S3.8 与 S10 组（维护者脚本，全程离线、用真实 bash 与 git），并用变异测试注入 10 个回退变异体证明护栏非恒真 —— 其中一条当场抓出一个假护栏：最初的路径用例在测试环境里跑不出 MSYS 形态（spawnSync 传给 bash 的 $PWD 已是 Windows 形态），把修复回退后它依然全绿，现改为打桩 cygpath 并直接注入 MSYS 形态的 $PWD。

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-cicd
manifest.description: 发布台（Release Console）for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a full main-panel page that show what each repository has built, what it has released, whether the local checkout is ahead of the release, whether the copy installed in this profile is the published artifact, and which version npm holds. 发布 is one press that does the whole release (发布同台): push the code, bump the version when the workflow would refuse it, dispatch release.yml asking for a draft, wait for that run, push npm, then make the draft public, then announce on Bilibili. The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. The separate buttons remain for a repository whose release must stay a draft. It also carries the third channel: when a release goes public, one short update note is posted under the video that introduces the plugin, with the credential obtained from a Bilibili sign-in inside the panel. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and the Host's own package manager, so the plugin stores no GitHub or npm credential of its own; the one credential it does own is the Bilibili session it created, kept in its own directory and never echoed back.

meta.title: DSH 插件发布台
meta.description: 面向 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布（CI/CD）：侧边栏图标 + 独立主面板，显示每个仓库的最近一次运行、已发布的 Release、本地是否领先于发布、本 profile 装的到底是哪一份（link: 本地检出 / Release 的 tgz），以及 npm 上是哪一版。浏览器登录、勾选仓库即可，复用本机已登录的 gh 与 Host 自己的包管理器，不另存 GitHub / npm 凭据。【发布】是一键发布（发布同台）：提交并推送代码 → 升版本（必要时）→ 触发 release.yml 取草稿 → 等 CI 成功 → 推 npm → 公开 Release → B 站播报，顺序不可换——npm 推送不可逆而草稿不是，所以 npm 失败时 Release 留在草稿、对外全有或全无，补上原因（如 2FA 一次性密码）即可继续，也可以选择跳过 npm 只公开 Release。装 Release 后面板接着问要不要重启（转发给 dsh-plugin-restart）；未登录 npm 时可在面板里粘贴 token 写入 npm 自己的 .npmrc。第三条渠道是 B 站更新播报：Release 公开后，在绑定的视频评论区自动补一条简短的更新说明——只认已公开的 Release（草稿不算），按 (仓库, tag) 幂等，绑定视频时写入基线所以不追发历史版本；凭据走面板内的 B 站登录（passport 网页二维码）或粘贴一次，落在插件自己的目录里、不回显，并且会真的去问一次账号接口——因为 biliup 默认写下的 cookies.json 是 BiliTV 登录，发评论走的却是 Web 接口。门禁与产包形状按 DSH bundle 设计（契约检查 + 整树 zip + 可安装 tgz + npm），任何带 ci.yml / release.yml 的仓库都能接。

comments.install: 本仓库当前为 v3 施工阶段（T01–T03 已交付）。按用户决策 D3：不执行 npm install / 不构建；devDependencies 仅作声明，实际安装留到可测试窗口（且必须先闭环 V24 数据根争用）。
comments.runtime: Node 22（本机实测 v22.22.2）。活动区为 ESM JS + JSDoc 类型（packages/plugin-workbuddy）；v1 时代的 node:sqlite 方案已随 src/ 冻结至 _legacy/，v3 会话映射落 ctx.settings。
comments.redlines: 四条 CI 红线（R3-7）：lint:c3 = C3 禁模拟点击；check:c2:exec = C2 进程出口审计（唯一出口 ctx.subprocess）；check:c2:probe = H-NO-EXEC-PROBE（探测路径零执行）；check:knobs = WB-7 设置面自证（声明的旗标要么真下发、要么写明惰性）。旧 check-c2-outbound.mjs（动态出站审计）已随 v2 退役移入 _legacy/，待续档按需重写启用。
comments.ui: UI = dsh 设置页插件卡片（lib/client.js 单文件 bundle，无构建器；朴素 createElement + 注入 CSS），无自研前端。
comments.publish: 仓库 = https://github.com/Zoupidan/DshAgentHub（2026-10-16 更名，原 dsh-control-plane；repository / homepage / bugs 三字段据此填写）。注意 private:true 仍在（防止误 publish）；本仓库不发布到 npm。

Without `prepare`, pnpm keeps a build only when the declared entry file is missing (packageShouldBeBuilt), so committing `lib/` makes git installs work as-is. capability.expected: The host half's CSS-only cover lands while <head> is still parsing, so DSH's [data-dsh-boot] card is never visible. The splash then mounts in a shadow root and retires the cover on the same task, plays its five stages to completion, and releases at the HOLD frame (0.84) only if the app is not yet ready. manifest.//bin: PENDENCIA DE `06-REPO-E-CI.md` §9.1 FECHADA (antecipada do COMMIT PREP 7). O alvo e o ARTEFACTO EMITIDO, nunca o `.ts`: um `bin` a apontar para fonte TypeScript e um symlink que o Node recusa executar. A emissao vem de `tsconfig.bin.json`, terceiro projeto de build — `bin/` nao cabe em `tsconfig.build.json` porque `rootDir` la e `src` e o `tsc` responde TS6059 (medido). O ficheiro so e executavel se `bin/dsh-guard-setup.ts` comecar por `#!/usr/bin/env node`; o `tsc` preserva o shebang mas nao o inventa.
manifest.//scripts: LIMPEZA DETERMINICA NO CAMINHO DO ARTEFATO: `build:all` comeca por `clean` (apaga `dist/` e `lib/`) para que o build compile SEMPRE para uma arvore limpa. Sem isto, artefactos compilados de modulos JA APAGADOS sobreviviam ao `tsc` (que so escreve o que a fonte ainda declara) e iao no tarball publicado — repro da revisao: `dist/worker/providers/discord/**` (8 modulos + sourcemaps do provedor removido, mtimes antigos) entrava no `pnpm pack` e a remocao era falsa no artefato. A defesa em profundidade e o gate do tarball: FORBIDDEN_PREFIXES do `scripts/check-tarball.mjs` rejeita `dist/worker/providers/discord/` e `lib/worker/providers/discord/`; guarda de regressao em test/unit/scripts/release-artefacts.test.ts. SEM `prepare`/`prepack` DE PROPOSITO — hooks de build correm no install de um git-dep e o pnpm 11 bloqueia-os (`ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED` em `pnpm add github:frederico-kluser/dsh-guard-messenger`), que e EXATAMENTE o que impedia o install-by-link (medido: o `prepack` sozinho ja bloqueia; so o `prepublishOnly`, que o pnpm nunca corre para dependencias, resta). O artefacto compilado (`dist/` + `lib/`) e COMMITADO no git — o padrao de `dsh-worktree-jump`, que instala por link sem `allowBuilds` — e `scripts/check-git-install.mjs` prova a instalacao por link de ponta a ponta; guarda de regressao em test/unit/scripts/install-by-link.test.ts. GATE DE FRESHNESS DOS ARTEFACTOS (`check:freshness`, primeiro passo do `package:check`): rebuilda com `build:all` e reprova QUALQUER divergencia dos artefactos COMMITADOS que o build reproduz (`git diff --exit-code dist lib` + `git status --porcelain` vazio: alterado, staged e NOVO EMITIDO PELO BUILD — ficheiros novos que o `git diff` nao mostra). FORA DO ALCANCE do gate, por medicao: um ficheiro criado A MAO em dist/ que o build nao emita e apagado pelo `clean` do `build:all` antes do porcelain e nunca chega ao pacote (o tarball passa pelo clean e o git-dep so serve `git ls-files`) — nao reprova e nao precisa de reprovar. Sem ele, artefactos STALE passavam todos os gates de PRESENCA verdes e o install por link servia o build antigo (repro: mudar uma string em `worker/surface/text.ts` sem rebuild); guarda em test/unit/scripts/freshness-artefactos.test.ts.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run clean && pnpm build && pnpm build:client
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.check:freshness: pnpm run build:all && git diff --exit-code dist lib && { s=$(git status --porcelain -- dist lib); test -z "$s" || { echo 'FALHOU check:freshness: dist/lib com alteracoes ou ficheiros novos face ao commit:'; echo "$s"; exit 1; }; }
scripts.package:check: pnpm run check:freshness && publint && attw --pack . && node scripts/check-tarball.mjs && node scripts/check-git-install.mjs && node scripts/fetch-dsh-types.mjs --check
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run package:check

manifest.//dsh: COM `dsh.bundle.patch`, por medicao — nao por leitura do manual. T1.3 fechou o spike S6 contra o CODIGO: o gate do registro `awesome-dsh-plugin` (`check-submission.mjs` L232) aceita `dsh.bundle` VAZIO, mas o produto nao: `dsh/lib/plugin-9h8shc4d.js:32` decide a ativacao por `dsh?.bundle?.patch !== void 0`, e `dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:548` LANCA no boot se um bundle listado nao declarar `.patch`. Declarar `bundle: {}` passaria no exame e reprovaria na vida: `dsh plugin add` nao ativaria nada. Medido com `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7` num $DSH_HOME limpo. Isto INVERTE a decisao de `06-REPO-E-CI.md` secao 9.1, que propunha `"dsh": { "bundle": {} }`.

manifest.name: @riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway
manifest.description: LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). Includes an insecure-origin UUID shim client bundle: on gateway-served plain-HTTP origins browsers lack crypto.randomUUID, so the client half patches a getRandomValues-backed randomUUID onto the Crypto prototype, fixing workspace open over LAN without touching DSH source.

_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
icon —— 插件图标（DSH 插件管理页显示）：相对 package.json 的图片路径，只认 svg/png/jpg/jpeg/webp，≤256 KiB，realpath 后必须留在包目录内；读取方是 dsh-app-boot 的 iconOf，会内联成 base64 data URL 塞进 meta.icon
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 对官方 DSH 完整版本逐项声明 compatible/incompatible/unknown；只写宽泛范围不算证据，商城最新三版至少需要一个 compatible
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/webm 播放资源（VP9-alpha，浏览器 Chrome/Edge/Firefox 与桌面模式共用）；Safari/HEVC 兼容由仓库流水线支持、fork 定制，不随包发布；assets/preview 的 GIF 仅 README 展示、不入包）
scripts.encode:webm —— 转码管线（step03 母版 → assets/webm 640×360 VP9-alpha）
scripts.build —— 构建完整产物 + files 收敛（node scripts/prepare.js）。克隆后手动跑一次；npm publish / npm pack 由 prepack 自动调用

scripts.prepack —— 发布前链：build（构建）→ typecheck/lint/format → prepack-check（素材健康检查）→ check:openapi。构建只挂这里：npm 11 会把 prepare 判为未批准的安装脚本，而 scripts/prepare.js 不随包发布（files 白名单只留 ensure-electron.mjs），用户一旦按提示批准就必然 ENOENT 失败
bin.dsh-pet-standalone —— 独立模式 CLI（构建产物 lib/standalone.js）：不打开 DSH 直接跑桌宠，把插件的宿主半边跑在伪 ctx 上；tsdown 的第二个入口负责构建，源码见 src/standalone/
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
engines —— Node.js 兼容下限（由运行依赖 @electron/get@5.1.0 的 engines 决定）

Esc or a click outside cancels. Plus a multi-instance-safe restart engine that stops only the current instance's tree (no more killing other DSH instances), waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object, confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route (the core /health route is behind the web token, so it cannot be used), watches it stay up, and brings the new window to the foreground so you can see the restart finished.

manifest.name: dsh-agent-memory
manifest.description: **v0.15 temporal dimension** — 时效维（论文 Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action · arXiv:2610.18126v1）：`reviewAfter`（复查死线 · YYYY-MM-DD · 写入侧接受 `+7d`/`+2w` 相对写法并**固化成绝对日期**）+ `watchFor`（观察条件 1–8 条）。论文核心：**新鲜度有天花板**（`Pr[f 在行动时仍成立] ≤ e^(-λΔact)`）——决策时取证再充分也突破不了执行间隙 Δact 里的变化；精度分解 `A=(1-π)K+π[ρS+(1-ρ)L]` 把剩余风险归给**路由**（新信息能否到达决策）与**判断**。实测：索引「决策文本」只达 37.5% 的关键消息；索引「全部背景」达 100% 却带 89 条噪音；**决策时写的观察条件达 92.2% 且仅 20 条噪音**（少而准才划算）。⚠ 三条**刻意不做**：① **不建独立 router**（recall 本身就是路由器——命中即看见「它在等什么」，免费路由；等有尸体再补）② **不设默认死线**（判断不代填：主人偏好该永久有效、环境坐标该 30 天一看，同一默认值会同时错两边）③ **到期 ≠ 作废**（只 = 该重看，不做自动失效/归档）。渲染只凸显需警觉档位（已过期 / 7 天内到期），新设与未设留空。**退出判据**：新写入带死线的比例长期 ≈ 0 ⇒ 撤或改形，不留死字段。**v0.14 grounding dimension** — 记忆的「约定状态」（论文 Grounding Awareness, arXiv:2610.18684 移植）：`established`（主人明确说过）/ `proposed`（**我提的、主人未回应**）/ `scoped`（接受但限范围）/ `rejected`（主人否决过）/ 缺省=未标注。⚠ **刻意不做强制门**——论文默认「未授权 ⇒ 必须确认」，但本系统主人的授权模式是「给方向、我自己决定」（AGENTS.md §2.2），处处请示会直接违背该定调 ⇒ 移植的是**可见性**（让我不被自己的提议骗）而非拦截。论文读数：未接受提议被记成「已确认信息」高达 86–100%，且给更多提议内容反而放大未授权执行（0.26→0.53）。渲染只凸显需警觉的三类（established/未标注留空）。**v0.13 subject dimension** — 记忆的「关于谁」维度（`self`=关于我 / `master`=关于主人 / 缺省=通用）。与 v0.5 `role`（谁写的）**正交**，且刻意不同三条：① **不做准入**（标记不是权限墙——不改变任何条目的可见性，故无需总开关）；② 未设=通用，存量条目零迁移；③ **允许显式转移**（`update({subject})`，与 I10 相反）——role 转移改可见范围故禁止，subject 只是标记，禁止则几百条历史记忆永远无法标注。三处可见：`recall`/`memory_browse` 过滤、`memory_stats` 分档、速览与 auto-recall 渲染标记（通用层留空）。 Agent-driven long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: scoped memory (global + per-workspace), layered entries (fact/knowledge/episodic), **role dimension for multi-agent workbench** (role-stamped writes + role-policy retrieval admission), **value auditor** (read-only memory_audit + proposal log), **context-centroid injection** (auto-recall query = weighted recent-turns terms, not just the last message + hit-rate metrics), **compaction-pipeline evidence layer** (per-bucket verdicts `not-ended`/`no-sources`/`already-summarized`/`pending` + `<DSH_HOME>/memory-compress-trace.jsonl` + memory_health readout), time-bucket compaction (day→week→month→year), associative recall (related chains) + memory_relate navigation, auto recall injection (CJK bigram search, tail append) with **v0.10 quality gates** (session-level entry dedup + IDF term weighting + generic-word gate + min-top-score gate — 无相关记忆时静默不注入), **v0.11 evidence-access & storage-hygiene fixes** (recall/memory_browse render now surface entry ids — they were long present in the output schema but dropped at the render layer, leaving update/forget/memory_merge without an entry point; compaction checkpoints now key on a **day-granular title** so repeated compactions in one day merge into a single episodic entry instead of leaving parallel snapshots; memory_audit gained `summary_max_chars` so an over-budget summary is flagged even below the generic 12k threshold), agent-decided content. **v0.12 DREAM-derived usage attribution** (memory_audit's usage term is now rank-weighted — `Σ decay^pos` over the returned list position instead of a raw hit count, so the #1 hit and the #20 hit no longer count the same; computed at parse time from the existing `ids` order ⇒ historical traces need no migration; `attributed ≤ hits` always, i.e. it can only stop over-crediting, never inflate; usage stays out of bucket decisions by construction, verified on the live 1,444-entry library with 0 bucket flips; the scoring basis is surfaced in both the structured notes and the rendered text).

manifest.name: aifp-mcp
manifest.description: AiFP Cognitive Memory — persistent memory MCP server for AI assistants. Chinese-first retrieval with causal chains, Hebbian associations and graph diffusion. 记忆感知系统
manifest.readme:
# AiFP 记忆感知系统 — MCP Server

通过 [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) 为 AI 编程助手提供持久记忆。

[English](./README.en.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aifp-mcp) · [GitHub](https://github.com/wjabanjj/aifp-mcp)

让 Obsidian、DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等一切支持 MCP 的 AI 工具拥有**跨会话的持续记忆**。完全本地运行，数据不出本机（默认 `~/.ai-cognition/`）。

## 为什么选 AiFP — 一套记忆，所有 AI 共享

你受够了 AI 的"健忘"吗？

- 聊了一上午，它忘了项目名——**存了，但用不上**
- 你说"拍森"，它只认 Python——**说错一个字就搜不到**
- 昨天说 Docker 连不上，今天说 MySQL 连不上，它不知道是同一件事——**相关的记不住**
- DeepSeek Harness 学会的，Claude Code 不知道——**每个 AI 都是记忆孤岛**

多数 AI 记忆系统只是**存**——存是存了，但用不上。AiFP 是让 AI 真正**记住、想通、共享**，把上面这些毛病一次解决。

**先讲别人做不到的（共享）：**

> **一套记忆，所有 AI 共用。** 今天 DeepSeek Harness 学会的，明天 Claude Code 还记得；Codex 攒的偏好，VS Code Copilot 不用重新问。别的记忆系统做不到——因为它们每个各记各的，互不相通。AiFP 让同电脑上所有 AI 工具共用一个大脑，**记一份，处处用**。

**再讲它为什么好用（能力）：**

- **会掂量着记**——不是每句话都存。聊的东西先进"待定区"，由识别器判断这条值不值得长期记住：值得才正式记下，不值得就跳过。不会一股脑全存，也不会错漏重要的。
- **能听懂人话**——你说"拍森"，它知道是 Python；你说"上个月"，它知道是哪个月。说错字、口语、时间词都能理解。
- **能看出关联**——昨天说"连不上数据库"，今天说"改了配置还不行"，它知道是同一件事的延续。还能顺着一条线索联想出相关的内容。
- **记得清，用得上**——一条记忆只留核心意思，不堆垃圾。用的时候只挑最相关的几条给你，又快又不乱。
- **越用越懂你**——你的偏好、习惯它会慢慢积累成"画像"，但它分得清"事实"和"建议"，不会把你的想法和它自己的混在一起。
- **该忘的就忘**——太久没用的记忆会自然淡出，重要的记忆会越来越牢。记忆库永远干净，不会变成堆不动的垃圾场。

**看这些名字，就知道它不简单**——记忆被做成了大脑的结构：

| 概念 | 它到底在干嘛（大白话） |
|------|----------------------|
| 🧠 **海马体 · 记忆感知** | 会掂量着记——先进"待定区"，识别器判断值不值得长期记住，值得才正式记下，不值得就跳过 |
| 🔗 **神经元突触 · 感知链** | 自动发现信息之间的联系，还能顺着线索找到最直接的关系 |
| 👃 **嗅觉皮层 · 语义检索** | 说错也能找到——你说"拍森"，它知道你要找 Python |
| ⚡ **共燃神经元 · 关联** | 一起出现的东西自动绑在一起，问 A 顺带带出 B |
| 🗣 **语言中枢 · 理解** | 懂口语、认错字、认得"上个月"是哪个月 |
| 🌊 **神经扩散 · 联想回忆** | 一条线索能联想出好几层相关的记忆 |
| 🧬 **突触固化 · 记忆巩固** | 用得越多记得越牢，从临时记忆慢慢变成长期记忆 |
| ⏳ **遗忘曲线** | 太久不用的自然淡出，记忆库永远干净不堆积 |
| 📊 **神经信号 · 置信度** | 每条记忆带个"可信度"标尺，越靠谱的越优先给你 |
| 👤 **主人认知模型 · 画像** | 懂你这个人——偏好习惯会积累成画像，但不跟它的想法混 |
| 💪 **肌肉记忆 · 跨轮复用** | 做过的经验跨会话记得，不用每次从头学 |

**天生为中文服务**：认错字、懂口语、认时间词，全都是为中文设计的。英文为主的记忆系统，遇到"拍森找 Python"这种就抓瞎了。

**默认完全私有**：所有数据都存你本机，不上云、不注册、不偷偷上报。所谓"共享"只是多个工具读写同一份本地记忆——**你的数据从没离开过这台电脑**。

**一条命令装好**：`npm install -g` 自动帮你配好 12 个 AI 工具（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Zed、VS Code Copilot、Codex CLI、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、pi-coding-agent）。

**一个大脑，多个助手**：今天 DeepSeek Harness 学到的，明天 Claude Code 还记得——像跟一个有记忆的同事说话，不用每次都重新自我介绍。

## 快速开始

```bash
npm install -g aifp-mcp
claude mcp add ai-cognition -s user -- npx aifp-mcp
```

重启 Claude Code 即可使用。数据存在 `~/.ai-cognition/data/cognition.db`。

### DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 自动接入

装完 `aifp-mcp` 后**自动接入 dsh**，无需手动执行任何 dsh 命令：

```bash
npm install -g aifp-mcp
```

安装时会自动检测 dsh 并写入配置（`~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）。重启 dsh，记忆工具自动注册为 `mcp__aifp__*`（如 `mcp__aifp__search_memories`、`mcp__aifp__save_memory`），无需手动改任何配置。

### 在任意 AI 对话中安装（推荐）

不需要手动配任何东西。在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、DeepSeek Harness 等任意工具里直接输入：

> 帮我安装记忆系统：`npm install -g aifp-mcp`

`postinstall` 钩子会**自动检测并配置所有已安装的 AI 工具**（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Zed、VS Code Copilot、Codex CLI、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、pi-coding-agent），并打印状态报告。重启工具即可使用记忆工具——AI 看到报告后会告诉你重启哪个，**无需手动改任何 MCP 配置文件**。

> **首次启动**：需要下载 ~30MB 的 bge-small-zh 嵌入模型，最多阻塞 45 秒。后续启动有缓存，秒开。

## 本地模式 vs 服务器增强模式

AiFP 支持两种运行模式（环境变量 `COGNITION_MODE`，默认 `remote`）：

本地模式完全私有（数据不出本机），但**感知链工具需要连接服务器**。服务器地址不随包分发，需通过官方接入渠道获取。

### 拿到 key 后，一条命令连上

> 接入地址和密钥通过官方渠道发放：**联系作者（微信：zm8571806/QQ：8571806/邮箱：8571806@qq.com）订阅后发放**，不随包公开。订阅到期可单独吊销，不影响其他用户。

```bash
# 1. 安装（如未安装）
npm install -g aifp-mcp

# 2. 一条命令连接服务器（地址和 key 由作者发放）
aifp-mcp --connect https://<官方地址> <你的64位key>

# 3. 重启你的 AI 工具（Claude Code / Cursor / dsh 等）
#    感知链 / 深度追踪 / 图扩散自动可用

# 断开（恢复纯本地）：
# aifp-mcp --disconnect
```

`--connect` 会把连接信息保存在本机 `~/.ai-cognition/server.json`，之后启动自动生效，无需每次配置环境变量。

### 更简单：直接让你的 AI 配置

不需要手动敲命令。在 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / dsh 等任何 AI 工具的输入框里说：

> 这是我的 aifp 服务器地址和 key，帮我配置：
> 地址：https://<官方地址>
> key：<你的64位key>

AI 会自动执行 `aifp-mcp --connect` 并提示你重启工具。重启后感知链增强自动生效。

> ⚠️ key 会出现在对话记录中，介意的话配置完可在管理后台吊销重发（不影响使用）。

### 接入 Obsidian（笔记 ↔ 记忆双向）

**Obsidian 笔记 → 记忆库**（AI 可语义检索你的笔记）：直接让你的 AI 导入，**无需配置环境变量**：

> 把 Obsidian 笔记导入记忆：directory = C:/Users/你/Obsidian/我的笔记库

AI 会调用 `reimport_sources` 同步导入（frontmatter 自动剥离、哈希去重）。以后新增笔记再说一次即可。

**记忆库 → Obsidian 笔记**（在 Obsidian 里看到全部记忆）：让 AI 调用 `export_memories_md`：

> 把记忆导出到 Obsidian：directory = C:/Users/你/Obsidian/我的笔记库/AiFP记忆

导出的笔记带 frontmatter（type/tier/tags），Obsidian 可直接识别和检索；同名笔记自动覆盖更新，保持与记忆库同步。


## MCP 工具（共 33 个）

核心工具（15 个）：

| 工具 | 功能 | 链路 |
|------|------|------|
| `save_memory` | 保存记忆（自动去重 + 向量索引） | 基础 |
| `search_memories` | 双路检索：FTS5 关键词 + 向量语义 | **逻辑链** |
| `recall_context` | 一键回忆（直接命中 + 因果链 + 关联 + 扩散） | **综合链** |
| `get_memory` | 按 ID 获取记忆详情 | 基础 |
| `list_memories` | 分页列出 | 基础 |
| `trace_perception_chain` | BFS 感知链追踪（6 类因果） | **上下链** |
| `find_perception_path` | 双向 BFS 找两条记忆间最短路径 | **关系链** |
| `get_perception_graph_stats` | 感知图统计 | **关系链** |
| `diffuse_memories` | 图扩散搜索（关联多跳） | **关系链** |
| `get_memory_tree` | 层级树结构 | 基础 |
| `get_related_memories` | Hebbian 共现关联 | **关系链** |
| `get_user_profile` | 用户画像——聚合偏好/事实/习惯 | **画像** |
| `observe_turn` | 记录对话轮次到识别队列（跨平台自动记忆入口） | **自动** |
| `reimport_sources` | 重新扫描外部笔记目录 | 导入 |
| `get_stats` | 系统统计 | 基础 |

另有 18 个管理/进阶工具：`consolidate_memories` / `share_memory` / `merge_memories` / `batch_delete` / `batch_update` / `export_memories` / `export_memories_md`（Obsidian）/ `explain_query` / `get_confidence_stats` / `scan_memory_patterns` / `validate_memory` / `get_top_experiences` / `deduplicate_memories` / `scan_observation_patterns` / `rotate_observation_logs` / `session_mine` / `derive_memories` / `flush_recognizer`。

## 跨平台自动记忆识别

Claude Code 使用原生 hooks（100% 自动，零遗漏）。其他工具通过 `observe_turn` 工具 + 指令文件实现（详见 `rules/` 目录）：

| 平台 | 配置方式 | 自动程度 |
|------|----------|----------|
| **Claude Code** | hooks（原生） | 100% 自动，零遗漏 |
| **Cursor** | `.cursor/rules/` 指令文件 | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |
| **Codex CLI** | `AGENTS.md` 指令文件 | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |
| **Trae** | 项目规则（手动配置） | AI 遵守指令时自动触发 |

指令文件告诉 AI："每次回答完用户后调用 `observe_turn` 记录本轮消息"。系统会自动判断是否有值得记住的内容，不需手动决定。

## 核心技术

- **SQLite + FTS5** 全文索引（CJK 感知，unicode61 tokenizer）
- **bge-small-zh-v1.5 向量嵌入**（本地 512 维语义搜索，自动重试 + 多镜像回退）
- **Hebbian 共现矩阵**（"一起发射的神经元连在一起"）
- **有向因果链**（6 种关系类型）
- **BFS 图扩散**（沿关联多跳发现间接知识）
- **纠错 + 消歧 + 中文时间词解析**

## 各 AI 工具怎么接入（自动或手动）

`npm install -g aifp-mcp` 时自动完成（postinstall 检测所有已装 AI 工具并写入 MCP 配置）。**以后新装了某个 AI 工具**，跑一次即可接入：

```bash
aifp-mcp --setup   # 重新检测并配置所有 AI 工具
```

自动检测并配置已安装的 AI 工具（检测到才写入，不重复覆盖）：

| 平台 | 配置方式 |
|------|----------|
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/settings.json` → mcpServers + 启动 hook |
| Cursor | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` |
| Windsurf | `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json` |
| Cline | `~/.config/cline/mcp_settings.json` |
| Gemini CLI | `~/.gemini/settings.json` → mcpServers |
| Qwen Code | `~/.qwen/settings.json` → mcpServers |
| Zed | `~/.config/zed/settings.json` → context_servers |
| VS Code Copilot | `%APPDATA%/Code/User/mcp.json` → servers |
| Codex CLI | `~/.codex/config.toml` |
| **pi-coding-agent** | 生成扩展到 `~/.pi/agent/extensions/aifp-memory/`（pi 无内置 MCP，用扩展机制） |

## 手动配置

### Claude Code / Cursor

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ai-cognition": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["path/to/aifp-mcp/dist/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 自定义数据目录

```bash
COGNITION_DATA_DIR=/path/to/data npx aifp-mcp
```

## 环境变量

| 变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|--------|------|
| `COGNITION_DATA_DIR` | `~/.ai-cognition/` | 数据存储目录 |
| `COGNITION_MODE` | `remote` | `local` 本地保底 / `remote` 连接服务器增强 |
| `COGNITION_SERVER_URL` | *（无默认，须显式配置）* | 远程算法服务器地址（自建） |
| `COGNITION_API_KEY` | - | 远程模式 API 密钥 |
| `COGNITION_RECOGNIZER` | `0` | 设为 `1` 启用自动识别 |
| `COGNITION_LLM_API_KEY` | - | 识别器 LLM 密钥（OpenAI 兼容） |
| `COGNITION_LLM_BASE_URL` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | 识别器 LLM 地址 |
| `COGNITION_LLM_MODEL` | `deepseek-chat` | 识别器 LLM 模型 |
| `HF_MIRROR` | `https://hf-mirror.com` | 嵌入模型下载镜像（失败自动回退 huggingface.co） |
| `CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | HTTP 模式跨域白名单 |
| `PORT` | `5000` | HTTP 端口 |

## 识别器 LLM 配置（启用自动记忆识别）

观察队列需要 LLM 判断是否值得入记忆，二选一：

```bash
# OpenAI 兼容（推荐：DeepSeek 等）
export COGNITION_RECOGNIZER=1
export COGNITION_LLM_API_KEY=你的DeepSeek密钥
export COGNITION_LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com   # 可选，默认同左
export COGNITION_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat                 # 可选

# 或 Anthropic
# export COGNITION_RECOGNIZER=1
# export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
```

不配置则只记录观察日志，自动识别不落地（AI 主动 `save_memory` 不受影响）。

manifest.name: dsh-maintainer-doc-guard
manifest.description: Keeps a long agent turn answerable to the user's actual request: a standing maintainer-document reminder, two pre-execute gates (read a same-basename precedent before editing infrastructure; say what a side-effecting step is for), an objective anchor that quotes the user's latest instruction plus an explicit precedence rule, and a nudge stage that corrects before it blocks. Details: (1) A standing system-prompt section that tells the model to read the workspace maintainer documents (plan.md / conventions.md / stack.md / state.md / maintainer/README.md) before every operation, so small-model context compaction cannot erase long-term project memory. (2) A `tools/pre-execute` precedent gate that denies a write/edit inside a guarded infrastructure area until a working same-basename precedent has been read. (3) A `tools/pre-execute` intent gate that polices the turn's side-effecting calls when the model never said what the step is for. (4) An OBJECTIVE ANCHOR: the user's latest instruction, quoted verbatim in a second prompt section with an explicit precedence rule (user's latest instruction > your own last stated plan > a lead you found yourself), so a long turn cannot silently redefine its own task. (5) A NUDGE stage that corrects before it blocks — the first unexplained action only injects a reminder the model reads at its next step, a drift reminder fires once per long turn, and only a repeated offence is denied. Plus a right-sidebar tab that views and edits those documents, and ten runtime knobs exposed in the harness settings page (设置 → 插件 → 插件配置).

One click sends a note (or merges several) into the current conversation — or forwards it into any chosen conversation — through the queue channel: when the target agent is busy the message is queued and processed after the running turn. Destructive clears are guarded by an in-panel confirm.

manifest.name: dedge-deepseek-harness-vscode
manifest.description: Self-contained DeepSeek Harness coding agent for VS Code with a Windows-safe runtime and isolated Codex/Claude handoffs.

virtualWorkspaces.description: DeepSeek Harness requires a local or remote filesystem-backed workspace.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The workbench and diagnostics remain available, but the Harness runtime cannot start until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: DeepSeek Harness: Configure Vision API Key
DeepSeek Harness: Clear Vision API Key

enumDescriptions: Use the platform runtime shipped in the VSIX.
Use an explicitly configured executable. No automatic downloads.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.mode.description: Runtime source. Bundled mode is the supported end-user path.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.command.description: Absolute path to a dsh executable or dsh JavaScript entry file when runtime.mode is external.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.nodePath.description: Required absolute Node executable when runtime.command points to a .js, .mjs, or .cjs entry file.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.runtime.startTimeou.description: Maximum time allowed for the local Harness host to become ready.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.model.description: Default model for newly created sessions. The official Harness RC exposes this as DeepSeek-V41-Flash with native text and image input.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.provider.description: Harness provider route. deepseek-official uses the native DeepSeek adapter; other routes use the bundled multi-provider pi-ai adapter.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.reasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for new sessions. Available values are provided by the selected model adapter.

enumDescriptions: Allow workspace and temporary-directory mutations; ask before wider access.
Allow unrestricted mutations without approval prompts.
Show an approval request for actions outside the workspace policy.
Keep workspace-write sandboxing and automatically allow each pending approval once.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.approvalPolicy.description: Approval behavior used with workspace-write permissions. Approve for me never enables unrestricted filesystem access.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.baseUrl.description: DeepSeek, Anthropic-compatible, or OpenAI-compatible API base URL. The official DeepSeek endpoint is used by default; self-hosted and sub2 endpoints may be configured here.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.autoStart.description: Keep one shared bundled runtime available after VS Code finishes starting, even when the workbench is closed.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.schedule.enabled.description: Mount the official DeepSeek Harness Host Schedule service by default. It adds durable session-bound reminders that survive Host restart; disable it if reminder tools should not be exposed to the model. Legacy session-log reminders need explicit recreation after upgrading. Requires a Harness restart when changed.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of editor context attached to a prompt.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.pasteFileTh.description: Pasted text larger than this many bytes is stored as a file in the extension storage; the prompt only receives the file path so the model can read it selectively.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.context.windowToken.description: DeepSeek context-window capacity in tokens. Defaults to the official adapter maximum (1M); the compaction-enabled official presets start automatic compaction at 80% to preserve response headroom, while manual compaction may run earlier when idle. Minimal has no compaction; custom presets define their own policy. Applies after a runtime restart.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.codexHome.description: Read-only Codex home used by the official app-server session list and the filtered JSONL fallback. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.claudeHome.description: Read-only Claude Code home used to discover local sessions. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.codexComman.description: Optional absolute path to a native Codex executable. Leave empty to discover the official CLI or VS Code extension binary without invoking a shell.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.claudeComma.description: Optional absolute path to a native Claude Code executable. Leave empty to discover the official VS Code extension binary or PATH executable without invoking a shell.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.maxBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 transcript bytes included in an isolated cross-platform handoff package.

enumDescriptions: Copy a ready-to-paste take-over prompt to the clipboard; start a new session in your Codex or Claude Code extension and paste it. Never spawns terminals.
Launch the native CLI/extension executable directly with the handoff prompt.
dedgeDeepSeekHarness.handoff.launchMode.description: How a hand-off to Codex or Claude Code is delivered. Clipboard mode keeps VS Code extensions (Codex, Claude Code) able to take over the task in their own session.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.skills.directories.description: Directories scanned for SKILL.md documents. Type @ in the composer to reference a skill; the referenced SKILL.md body is attached to the prompt when sending. ${userHome} and ~ are expanded by the extension.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.baseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible auxiliary vision endpoint. When enabled from the composer, it describes images in an extra request before Harness receives the prompt.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.model.description: Auxiliary vision model name. This model is called only when the composer auxiliary-vision toggle is enabled.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.modelOverrid.description: Per-main-model auxiliary vision toggle values managed by the composer. False sends images directly when the main model supports them.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.compaction.provider.description: Optional provider used for compaction summaries. Empty inherits the conversation route.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.compaction.model.description: Optional model used for compaction summaries. Empty inherits the conversation route.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.reasoningEff.description: Optional reasoning_effort sent to the Vision endpoint. Leave empty for providers that do not support this parameter.

dedgeDeepSeekHarness.vision.maxBytes.description: Maximum encoded image bytes sent to the vision endpoint per attached image.

manifest.name: dsh-tailscale-remote
manifest.description: Publishes the DSH Web GUI on your tailnet whenever DSH runs, so a phone anywhere can connect, and removes the route on exit. Every remote page is the lite plugin set by default (about 1.1 MB gzip instead of about 5.3 MB) and the full page only happens when you press the switch icon once (the choice is never remembered) — the desktop app never sees any of it (this plugin registers nothing there) and startup cost is zero because the WebSocket compression patch is armed lazily on the first handshake. The phone link lives in Settings -> General -> Phone access with one-click copy and key rotation: rotating revokes the old link and every session signed with it. The same link is in the loginUrl field of ~/.dsh/tailscale-remote.json.
manifest.author: Ckarefulon

dshComment: No 'bundle' key on purpose, and its absence is the isolation guarantee.
Declaring 'dsh.bundle.patch' is what makes 'dsh plugin add' append this package to a
profile's 'dsh.profile.bundles', which would apply cordis.patch.yml and give Raven a
host-plane row. That row registers the settings namespace, and a settings page is
global: a user in any other mode would see a Raven card. It also decides the browser
half, because the web app loads a package's client bundle only when the composition
carries a row naming that package.
So installing this package contributes nothing until a session is started in Raven
mode. cordis.patch.yml is still shipped, as an opt-in overlay for a deployment that
wants the card and accepts losing isolation; see the comments in that file.

peerDependenciesComment: Every peer is '*' on purpose, and it is not laziness about ranges.
A profile installs plugins with autoInstallPeers:false and nodeLinker:hoisted precisely so an
out-of-tree plugin's peers fall through to the RUNNING Harness installation and every plugin
shares ONE cordis instance. A narrowed range cannot make a mismatched deployment work: it makes
the install fail, or resolves a second copy whose services the Harness cannot see -- a failure
that looks like an absent service rather than a version conflict. So the range is not where
The 'dshRaven' block at the bottom of this file is. It names the exact Harness version and commit
this build was tested against, scripts/verify-dsh.ts is the executable check of it, and the
release workflow refuses to publish without it. Read the pin, not the ranges, to know what runs.
Consequence to accept: a pre-1.0 prerelease that reshapes a seam gives NO install-time signal here. The
pin plus 'pnpm run test:dsh' against a matching checkout is the only thing that catches it, which
is why that gate is mandatory before a release. See README.md, 'Version pinning and peer dependencies'.

_注释: dsh.manifestVersion 与 engines.dsh 内核目前不强制校验（dsh-package-manifest README 明说），保留是为了将来收紧时不用改包。
repository 地址即 GitHub 公开仓库；插件市场收录要另外向 awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin 提 PR（没有 npm 关键字自动发现）。
scripts 用带引号的 glob 而不是『node --test test/』：Node 22+ 传目录会把它当模块入口解析，报 Cannot find module .../test；测试文件统一命名 *.test.js。
icon 必须是包内相对路径（不能是 emoji 或 URL），格式限 SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP 且 ≤256KiB。
engines.dsh 一旦声明，@deepseek-ai/dsh* 的 peerDependencies 就不再参与内核兼容判定（dsh-app-boot 的 if/else），所以范围要自己定得合理：整个 0.2 大版本放行，避免内核打补丁就整插件被拒。
peerDependencies 只是给 pnpm 解析用的声明，全部 optional，不实际安装内核包。
peer 范围必须逐个小版本枚举预发布分支：node-semver 只放行「元组相同且自身带预发布标签」的比较符，所以 >=0.2.0-rc.0 <0.3.0-0 匹配不到 0.2.1-rc.2（内核当前版本），用户装包会撞 ERESOLVE。这里枚举到 0.2.9 覆盖整条 0.2 线；内核进入 0.3 或新增小版本时要同步扩这个范围。
files 必须包含 cordis.patch.yml，否则安装后校验 dsh.bundle 会 not-bundle 失败并回滚。
客户端入口只由 exports["./client"] 决定，没有 dsh.client.entry/files 这种字段；dsh.client 只认 platform/inject/external/immediately 四个键，未知键被静默忽略。
dsh.client.inject 只列真的会用的：ui-settings 声明 settings.section 槽，locale 提供中文文案。react 在外壳基座模块表里，不必列。写错包名会让整张启动图组合失败。

_comment: 无构建步骤：lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js 就是手写源码（纯 JS，无 TS/打包）。
宿主半侧(host)：ESM，导出 name / inject / apply，注册 /dsh-hotspot 前缀路由。
浏览器半侧(client)：必须是「普通副作用脚本」——加载时调 window.__ModuleLoader__.load，
顶层不能有 import/export，react 由 factory 的 require 取得。
dsh.bundle.patch → 声明本包是 bundle，安装后 patch 自动进层栈。
dsh.client → 声明浏览器半侧，DSH 模块系统据此提供 /plugins/hotspot/client.js。
这里 inject 故意留空：本插件不依赖任何官方 client 包，降低版本门槛。
id 必须与包名一致（商城上架契约按它比对 entryIds），见 cordis.patch.yml。
未声明 dsh.compatibility：尚未在真实 DSH 版本上实测，不做无证据的兼容声明。
v0.2.0：日内多次采样（+ 旧格式兼容读）、跨榜飙升榜、用 ctx.llm 生成中文简介。
v0.7.1：预热与采样解耦（重启也会补判定）、预热条数提到整页 50、清理重复注释。
v0.7.0：三套视觉密度预设（只落 --hs-* 局部变量）+ 采样后主动预热相关性判定。
v0.6.0：界面全量改用 --dsw-* 设计 token + 官方图标组件（缺图标降级为字形），重做信息层级与无障碍。
v0.5.0：模型相关性判定 + 综合打分（剔除平台级/合集/无关），区间改为 as-of-boundary（两端都取采样）。
v0.4.0：按日程更新 —— 每个「榜单 × 周期」有自己的边界，跨过边界才重算，其余时间冻结；
抓数据也从「每 5 分钟」改为「每天 0 点一次」（7 次请求/天），各周期区间=上一边界→本边界。
v0.3.0：榜单改为挂 shell.overlay 的独立可拖拽浮层（拖动/缩放/折叠成药丸/隐藏，位置记忆）。
v0.2.1：修两处 —— ① 采样合并不再推进 at（否则一天只剩一个采样，飙升榜永远没数据）；
② 简介解析改用 dsh-llm 的真实 text-delta 分片协议 + 自带兜底实现（实测该包在本地
node_modules 里没 package.json、且是指向 npx 缓存的链接，裸 import 与绝对路径 import 都失败）。

manifest.name: dsh-llm-auto
manifest.description: DSH 宿主插件:注册一个 `auto` 模型路由,内部按配置的有序链依次尝试多条「provider + model」;某条在**产出任何内容之前**失败时,先按官方同款策略在该路由内原地重试(瞬时错误白名单,默认 5 次),重试耗尽才静默切下一条,对上层表现为一个普通模型;并可用 compactWindow 把自动压缩点钉在指定 token 数附近。0.4.0 起自带浏览器半侧:插件页该 bundle 的卡片上直接渲染配置表单,可直接改 compactWindow(官方 SettingsForm 原语,保存才写入)。0.5.0 起同一处再渲染只读「回退链」面板:当前生效链 + 最近若干次请求的真实回退过程(数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes,打开页面时读一次、可手动刷新)。0.5.2 起:DeepSeek 原生路由可用 routes[i].keepThinking 保留工具循环思考,缺省仍摘;(B1/B2) 跨路由的历史思考改为从 content 与 replayState.blocks 同步摘掉,不再被上游降级成正文;(B) 真的发生静默路由切换时,在出站消息末尾追加一条与 DSH 自带同款的 model changed 通知(只改出站负载、不写会话记录)。0.5.3 起:新增 routes[i].breakToolLoop —— 历史里存在「带工具调用却没有思考块」的助手消息、且出站以工具结果结尾时,在出站消息末尾追加一条用户提示,把请求改成「以用户消息结尾」,绕开 DeepSeek thinking 模式的工具循环校验(这种情形下思考是「从来没有」,keepThinking 挡不住)。0.6.0 起:routes 成为可写配置,插件页那张卡片上的「回退链」面板升级成可编辑 —— 拖拽排序、从 live 模型目录(新增 GET /api/llm-auto/catalog)里选模型、按行开关 keepThinking/breakToolLoop;写入走官方设置服务落进 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml(注释保留),靠懒读 volatile 引用免重启生效。0.7.0 起:同一张卡片上再多一段**只读**的「额度」摘要 —— 链上两家订阅的余额/窗口用量(Command Code 的美元余额 + 5h/周窗口,OpenCode Go 的 5h/周/月三档百分比),数据来自 /api/llm-auto/routes 新增的 quota 字段;宿主侧只读查询、按 TTL 缓存、永不因此改变端点状态码,**查不到就显示「不可查」而不是 0**;同一个响应里还在确有 profile 覆盖时多一个 user.routes,让面板的「恢复包内默认链」按钮终于有判据可依。0.8.0 起:回退链的顺序改由插件**按订阅额度自动决定** —— 有月度重置时刻的订阅按「越早重置越靠前」排,查不到重置时刻的按配置顺序,永不过期的按量兜底排最后;某一跳因窗口额度耗尽被拒(错误码 QUOTA)时,插件补查该来源的额度接口,确认后把它冷却到对应窗口的重置时刻、期间不再尝试,到点自动恢复(进程内冷却表,不落盘)。新增 volatile 配置键 ordering.mode(auto 默认 / manual = 回到 0.7.0 的「完全按 routes 顺序」),插件页那张卡片上多一段「自动排序」摘要与开关;/routes 响应新增只读字段 ordering(effective 实际尝试顺序 + cooldown 冷却表),chain 仍是配置顺序。0.9.0 起:插件页那张卡片的界面**按排序模式收敛** —— 模式开关(自动/手动)挪到卡片最上面、在「回退链」标题之前;自动模式下主视图是「生效顺序」(插件排出来的实际尝试顺序),可编辑的配置链折进默认收起的「配置顺序」折叠项(点开照旧可拖可改),提示语也换成「自动排序生效中」那句;手动模式下主视图就是那条可编辑的链,不画生效顺序。0.9.1 起:放宽「窗口额度耗尽」判据 —— 不再要求 `usage limit` 紧跟 exhausted/reached(Command Code 的实际文案是 `You've reached your weekly usage limit for your plan. Your limit resets at …`,旧判据对它返回 false,于是每次请求都先白撞 CC 并原地重试 6 次),改为「窗口词 + 额度词 + 耗尽/重置词三者同时成立」;该判据由宿主侧(补查额度、冷却该 provider)与适配器侧(不再原地重试,直接切下一条)共用同一个函数。0.10.0 起:`auto` 在模型选择器的档位面板上只有两档 ——「Default」(插件一个推理档位都不写,交回宿主/上游默认)与「max」(逐条路由取该家最高档,与 0.9.x 的旧行为逐字等价);声明面是 `resolveModel()` 的 `reasoning.efforts=[max]` 且**不给** `defaultEffort`(给了就没有 Default 那行)。⚠ 要让「默认档」真的不带推理强度,pi-ai 路由的 profile 里不能有 route 级 `reasoning:` —— 本机 2026-10-09 已从 desktop / headless 两个 profile 删掉。0.11.0 起:冷却表**落盘** —— 结论写进宿主领域存储(域 llm_auto_cooldown / 表 cooldowns,介质 <DSH_HOME>/storages/llm_auto_cooldown.json),跨 dsh 重启与插件重组合存活到重置时刻,不再有「重启后第一条白撞」;被 QUOTA 拒的当下先同步记一条 5 分钟短闸门(补查确认后换成重置时刻),周期补查见该家已恢复则自动解冻,面板冷却行右侧多一个「解除」按钮(走设置服务的 ordering.unfreeze 一次性指令,不新增写端点),并显示冷却表落盘状态;存储服务缺席 / 打开失败 / 写入失败一律降级为纯内存 + warn,绝不影响注册与请求。0.11.1 起:把「解除冷却」指令的**已消费记录也落盘** —— 面板写进配置的那条 ordering.unfreeze 值一变就生效,但面板自己**不会清掉它**,而 0.11.0 只把「消费过了」记在内存里 ⇒ 宿主重启后旧指令会被当成新指令再消费一次(清冷却 + 删介质记录 + 第一条请求又白撞那家,2026-10-12 真机实测:撞 Go 948 ms 被判 QUOTA → 切走 → 6 秒后介质被重写成 source=confirm)。0.11.1 把这个值写进冷却域(域 llm_auto_cooldown)的 global 槽 —— 不改域名 / version / cooldowns 表结构,老介质(global: null)照旧能打开 —— 水合时读回来,同一个值永不再触发。另加一条**陈旧判据**:指令里的 epochMs 早于宿主**进程**启动时刻 ⇒ 只记为已消费、不做任何解除动作并 warn(面板不可能在宿主没运行时被点到;用进程启动时刻而不是插件 apply 时刻,免得重组合把合法点击误判成陈旧);配置里现存的那条旧指令因此在升级后的第一次重启也不会再撞一次。已知代价:宿主停机期间(或点完还没被消费就重启)的「解除」不会被事后补偿,重启后再点一次即可;写 global 失败 / 读不出来都只 warn,冷却水合照旧。

comment: 本阶段（阶段 4 最小框架）刻意不设置构建步骤：src 下的 .js 就是运行代码，
DSH 用 Node ESM 直接加载，省掉 tsc/tsdown 与 lib/ 产物，改完即生效。
待模块规模变大后再引入构建（届时 main 指向 lib/index.js）。
comment_electron: 刻意**不**把 electron 列为依赖。官方做法（npm install electron）会把它下载到
项目的 node_modules，而本机实测：工作区目录内的 electron.exe 启动即崩
因此运行时必须装在工作区之外，用 npm run install:electron 装到 $DSH_HOME/electron/。
详见 README 的『环境约束』一节。
comment_install: 装进 DSH 用 `npm run install-plugin`（= node scripts/install.mjs）。
它只改 profile 的 package.json 里 dsh.profile.bundles 与 dependencies 两个字段，
然后跑 pnpm install，最后验证能解析到插件入口。完整指引见 INSTALL.md。

manifest.name: dsh-dock
manifest.description: One-click desktop launcher for DSH Harness: automatically installs a prebuilt native app (DSH Harness.exe, whale icon) on the desktop when the plugin activates (parameters auto-detected from the environment); the app starts DSH hidden and opens the GUI as a fullscreen Edge app window, and leaves a tray-resident whale with live server status, one-click server restart and optional boot autostart. Candidate discovery is adaptive: it auto-scans every global install the machine exposes — the running Node, roaming npm, WinGet Node versions and nvm-windows version dirs — by probing each unique node's `npm root -g` (v0.6), and lets the user add any custom install path from the settings page (v0.7), so no one ever has to relocate a differently-installed dsh. v0.8: the tray poll cadence adapts to state (1.5s while booting/restarting, 15s steady) and a file watcher delivers the sidebar restart request, Full exit finishes as soon as the host signals disposal instead of waiting out a fixed watchdog, and a restart request is consumed exactly once.

comment: 本阶段（阶段 4 最小框架）刻意不设置构建步骤：src 下的 .js 就是运行代码，
DSH 用 Node ESM 直接加载，省掉 tsc/tsdown 与 lib/ 产物，改完即生效。
待模块规模变大后再引入构建（届时 main 指向 lib/index.js）。
comment_electron: 刻意**不**把 electron 列为依赖。官方做法（npm install electron）会把它下载到
项目的 node_modules，而本机实测：工作区目录内的 electron.exe 启动即崩
因此运行时必须装在工作区之外，用 npm run install:electron 装到 $DSH_HOME/electron/。
详见 README 的『环境约束』一节。
comment_install: 装进 DSH 用 `npm run install-plugin`（= node scripts/install.mjs）。
它只改 profile 的 package.json 里 dsh.profile.bundles 与 dependencies 两个字段，
然后跑 pnpm install，最后验证能解析到插件入口。完整指引见 INSTALL.md。
