manifest.//files: 根包打包边界（v1.4.7 收面批）：private:true 只拦得住 npm publish，拦不住 npm pack / --dry-run。此前既无 files 也无 .npmignore → npm 回退用 .gitignore 排除 → 排除不到 → 实测打过 1621 文件 / 17.3 MB 解包，平铺含 FORGE/ docs/ engine/ tools/ SKILL/ FDE/ .claude/ .cursor/（把内部施工面连同一份含凭证路径说明的配置一起打进 tarball）。本字段把根 pack 收敛到根级必要文件。⚠️ 不影响 @sofagent/* 各 workspace 包（各自 files 独立限定，如 engine/umbrella 恒为 3 文件）；也不影响 install.sh（走 git clone 钉发版 tag，不走 npm pack）。⚠️ 维护注意：根 pack 只用于边界收口，无任何发布/安装链路依赖它——新增根级文件如确需随包分发再显式登记。
manifest.//build-scope: 根 build 覆盖边界（v1.5.1 K4 显式声明，非缺陷）：scripts.build 按拓扑序显式枚举 22 个子命令 = 22 个 workspace 包（其中 engine/dsh-plugins/plugin-kit 以 `npm --prefix` 形态调用而非 --workspace，故仍先于全部 DSH 插件构建——构建拓扑序由本字段手工钉住）。27 项 workspaces 中未被根 build 覆盖的 5 项为：engine/umbrella（无 build 脚本——纯转发壳，bin/sofagent.js 是源码级入口，合理）+ 4 个 engine/openclaw-plugins/sofagent-{audit,evolve,inject,rollback}。⚠️ 后 4 个**各自带 build 脚本但刻意不随根 build 构建**——它们走 OpenClaw 独立分发通道（ClawHub），产物面与根 monorepo 的 npm 发布面相互独立；install.sh 亦不消费其 dist（故当前无故障，属显式声明的潜伏断链收口）。ClawHub 通道构建验证点（v1.5.8 BUG-31 登记）：发版前由维护者在本地对 4 包各跑 `npm --prefix engine/openclaw-plugins/<pkg> run build` 确认零报错 + dist 时间戳更新，随发版阶段九（双分发）取证记录在 devlog（`clawhub build ok ×4` 一行）；ClawHub 上架后的可用性以平台安装回验为准。如需改为纳入根 build、或在文档中另作声明，须先确认分发形态。

_comment: type/main —— 宿主入口 lib/index.js，纯 ESM 的 Cordis 插件（name/inject/apply）；
本包不打包：源码即产物，DSH 直接加载，装完即可用，无需构建步骤。
只有宿主半侧，**没有浏览器半侧**：照照只以「独立 Electron 置顶窗」的形式存在，
浮在所有应用之上。因此这里**不声明 dsh.client、也不导出 ./client** ——
声明了却没有对应文件，DSH 的模块系统会去加载 /plugins/<name>/client.js 并失败。
icon —— 插件管理页图标（PNG，<=256KiB，realpath 后须留在包目录内）。
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件 cordis.patch.yml，安装后自动进层栈。
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 逐项声明完整版本；这些行都是在对应 DSH 版本上实测通过的。
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录：lib（宿主代码）、runtime/electron-helper（桌面窗）、
assets/pet（6 段透明 webm）+ assets/icon.png、scripts/ensure-electron.mjs、cordis.patch.yml。
⚠️ assets/cook-已抠图 是**素材源**（几十 MB 的 mp4），绝不随包发布。

_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
icon —— 插件图标（DSH 插件管理页显示）：相对 package.json 的图片路径，只认 svg/png/jpg/jpeg/webp，≤256 KiB，realpath 后必须留在包目录内；读取方是 dsh-app-boot 的 iconOf，会内联成 base64 data URL 塞进 meta.icon
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 对官方 DSH 完整版本逐项声明 compatible/incompatible/unknown；只写宽泛范围不算证据，商城最新三版至少需要一个 compatible
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/webm 播放资源（VP9-alpha，浏览器 Chrome/Edge/Firefox 与桌面模式共用）；Safari/HEVC 兼容由仓库流水线支持、fork 定制，不随包发布；assets/preview 的 GIF 仅 README 展示、不入包）
scripts.encode:webm —— 转码管线（step03 母版 → assets/webm 640×360 VP9-alpha）
scripts.build —— 构建完整产物 + files 收敛（node scripts/prepare.js）。克隆后手动跑一次；npm publish / npm pack 由 prepack 自动调用

scripts.prepack —— 发布前链：build（构建）→ typecheck/lint/format → prepack-check（素材健康检查）→ check:openapi。构建只挂这里：npm 11 会把 prepare 判为未批准的安装脚本，而 scripts/prepare.js 不随包发布（files 白名单只留 ensure-electron.mjs），用户一旦按提示批准就必然 ENOENT 失败
bin.dsh-pet-standalone —— 独立模式 CLI（构建产物 lib/standalone.js）：不打开 DSH 直接跑桌宠，把插件的宿主半边跑在伪 ctx 上；tsdown 的第二个入口负责构建，源码见 src/standalone/
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
engines —— Node.js 兼容下限（由运行依赖 @electron/get@5.1.0 的 engines 决定）

manifest.name: source-code-mgmt
manifest.description: DSH plugin: source code management. Registers「代码管理」as a card in DSH's OWN right sidebar (the official guide page, beside 工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器) and as a tab page in that column — there is no separate button. Older hosts degrade gracefully: dsh-better-sidebar (if installed) gets a Tab; a host with neither gets a header entry (beside "Session log", plus a same-height pinned one in the empty state). Nothing is ever placed in DSH's own left sidebar. The SSH section lets you choose port 443 (through firewalls that block 22) or the standard 22, and switching rewrites ~/.ssh/config in place. Repo status batches its git calls (one numstat for all changed files, one `remote -v` for name+URL), cutting a load on a busy repo from ~1.3s to ~0.06s. Opens a panel with env checks (git/gh), SSH ed25519 key setup, GitHub/Gitee dual-platform (SSH config + Gitee OpenAPI), connectivity test, push / new repo, auto-ignore files over 100MB with per-file skipped reasons, a clone section (remote repos from your account with local-exists detection, plus clone any repo by URL into any location), and a five-step npm publish wizard. Cross-platform (Windows / Linux / macOS).

manifest.name: dsh-whale-girl
manifest.description: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的鲸鱼娘：会说话（本地 ASR + 晓伊语音）、会看屏幕（采集卡/窗口捕获）、会陪玩（回合制与策略游戏代打）。基于 dsh-pet（MIT, PC2005-cloud）扩展。
_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
icon —— 插件图标（DSH 插件管理页显示）：相对 package.json 的图片路径，只认 svg/png/jpg/jpeg/webp，≤256 KiB，realpath 后必须留在包目录内；读取方是 dsh-app-boot 的 iconOf，会内联成 base64 data URL 塞进 meta.icon
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-whale-girl/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 对官方 DSH 完整版本逐项声明 compatible/incompatible/unknown；只写宽泛范围不算证据，商城最新三版至少需要一个 compatible
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/webm 播放资源（VP9-alpha，浏览器 Chrome/Edge/Firefox 与桌面模式共用））
scripts.encode:webm —— 转码管线（step03 母版 → assets/webm 640×360 VP9-alpha）
scripts.build —— 构建完整产物 + files 收敛（node scripts/prepare.js）。克隆后手动跑一次；npm publish / npm pack 由 prepack 自动调用

scripts.prepack —— 发布前链：build（构建）→ typecheck/lint/format → prepack-check（素材健康检查）→ check:openapi。构建只挂这里：npm 11 会把 prepare 判为未批准的安装脚本，而 scripts/prepare.js 不随包发布（files 白名单只留 ensure-electron.mjs），用户一旦按提示批准就必然 ENOENT 失败
bin.dsh-whale-girl-standalone —— 独立模式 CLI（构建产物 lib/standalone.js）：不打开 DSH 直接跑桌宠，把插件的宿主半边跑在伪 ctx 上；tsdown 的第二个入口负责构建，源码见 src/standalone/
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
engines —— Node.js 兼容下限（由运行依赖 @electron/get@5.1.0 的 engines 决定）

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && node scripts/prepack-check.js && npm run check:openapi

_comment_deps: QQ 群接入（src/qq/onebot.ts）**不加新依赖**：Node 22.4+ 的内置 WebSocket 支持构造期 headers
（NapCat 的 access_token 走 Authorization 头）、bufferedAmount 背压与关闭码，实测够用
（见 docs/QQ.md「为什么不用 ws 包」）。云端只需 node + python3 + ffmpeg。

manifest.name: @jipika/dsh-memory
manifest.description: Progressive long-term memory for DSH: sharded markdown bodies under ~/.dsh/memory/topics/, with only a live-generated map (shard · keywords · count · latest date) injected into the system prompt, entries pulled on demand via grep + read — so the prompt cost stays flat however large the memory grows. Two layers (global + per-project) plus the global rule files, viewable AND editable in DSH Settings, with per-layer switches and an index/full injection toggle. v0.5.0 adds enforcement hooks: a write guard on the native tool pipeline (format/secrets/history rules, optional external command judge, deny/ask with reasons fed back to the model), post-write audit log, a read reminder when memory files are read, a mandatory discipline block, and an optional injection filter command. Zero extra LLM cost, live re-read. v0.5.1 keeps the switches in ~/.dsh/memory/settings.json — read live by the plugin and edited from the settings pane over the plugin's own route, independent of the host settings API. v0.6.0 fixes the index silently degrading to a title-less directory once memory outgrew the hardcoded 9k budget (which is why an agent could see memory injected and still never read it): the index now shrinks per-shard along a newest-N-per-shard ladder under a configurable indexBudget, adds per-shard keywords (routing hint) and latest-entry dates, ships a 'check memory before starting a task' discipline, and makes full mode read the shard bodies (auto-falling back to index when over budget) instead of the retired memory.md navigation file. v0.7.0 makes 'map' the default injection mode (shard-level map only, no entry titles): retrieval = grep the memory dir with task keywords, then read the matched line; layers with <=12 entries stay inlined; the discipline block teaches that two-step path and routes cross-shard lookups (>=3 entries / >=2 shards / >=3k body) to a subagent that returns facts + line numbers instead of raw bodies. v0.9.0 adds the card-memory layer for roleplay sessions and makes every path Windows-safe: home resolution follows os.homedir() (so an undefined or empty HOME no longer roots paths at the drive root), tool and bash paths are normalized before guard matching, and drive-letter cwds produce valid project slugs. v0.9.2 fixes retrieval ranking at scale (IDF-weighted entry scores, df=0 CJK bigram fragments excluded from the coverage gate, BM25-style length normalization, preview windows anchored on the rarest matched token instead of a fixed 240-char head cut; measured locally: shards covered per top-8 2.88->5.75, largest tie block 4.38->1.13, previews containing a matched token 67%->100%): shard-level bonuses no longer inflate every entry in that shard (they were added inside the entry loop, so all hits from one shard shared an identical score and ordering collapsed to date-then-line), a per-shard quota stops one shard from filling the whole result page, and the default scope is the current project layer (other projects' shards — 60% of the pool locally — are skipped but reported in dropped.offScopeLayers/offScopeFiles, with scope:'all' to opt back in).

scripts.//check: Build runs BEFORE typecheck on purpose. Each adapter resolves the core through the `jevcore` workspace link, and the core's `types` entry is `lib/index.d.ts` — which does not exist until it is built. Typechecking first works on any machine that already has a `lib/` and fails on a clean checkout, which is exactly how CI caught it.
scripts.//check:workflows: Runs before build, beside the other gates that read committed text rather than build output. It exists because the trap it catches fired twice in this repository: bash performs command substitution on backticks inside a `run:` block before the program in that block sees the text, so a backtick written in a JavaScript comment inside `node -e "..."` is executed as a shell command. The first occurrence was diagnosed and documented in a NOTE; the second was added by the change that wrote this gate.
scripts.//check:docs: Runs BEFORE build, and reads no build output: it compares docs/ with the copies in packages/*/docs, both of which are committed. The placement is about repairs, which is what separates it from check:mojibake below. That gate's drift half has to run after the build because only a build clears a stale artifact, so running it earlier printed the same advisories on every un-rebuilt tree. Nothing in this chain clears a stale copy — `build` compiles TypeScript and never reads `docs/`, so a copy that is behind stays behind until someone runs the sync. Failing before a build that cannot help is therefore the cheap order, and it sits beside `legal` because it is the same kind of gate: a generated directory that `files[]` ships, asserted by its own `--check` mode and repaired by running its script.
scripts.//check:mojibake: Runs AFTER build, not before. Before it, every un-rebuilt edit made the chain print the same stale-artifact advisories; noise on the normal path is how a real finding gets skimmed past, and nothing ships on that path anyway — release.yml runs this whole chain, build included, before it publishes. After it, the corruption half scans the artifact the build just produced, and the drift half stays quiet unless a rebuild could not have fixed what it found.
scripts.check: pnpm run legal && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:readmes && pnpm run check:workflows && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:mojibake && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test

manifest.description: 给 Agent 一套它自己管得住、你也看得见的记忆：20 个语义工具、7 种意图召回、可切换策略栈、项目隔离、预设即权限、事件溯源与可回滚、离线检索基准；零运行时依赖、离线、单文件 JSONL，并自带设施仪表盘与终端可视化。

network: registry.npmjs.org (HTTPS GET only, and only when the core row sets updateCheck = npm — the shipped bundle does; set it to `off` for a fully offline install). It reads https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-anagenesis/latest, compares that version with its own package.json version and shows the result in the window/dashboard. It sends no identifiers (no instance id, no project fingerprint, no memory content), downloads nothing, installs nothing and changes no file. Every failure is shown as a state ("check failed: ...") and never blocks anything else.

permissions.filesystem: dsh-anagenesis owns $DSH_HOME/anagenesis/ (journal/*.jsonl append-only log + snapshot.json). For read compatibility with the pre-rename layout it will ALSO open $DSH_HOME/evolution/ when the new directory does not exist yet, and it never moves that data on its own — `tools/migrate-store.mjs` does the copy and only when the operator runs it. It reads and writes nothing else; it never opens another plugin's memory store. The visualization row only reads that store, and `tools/viz-watch.mjs` is a standalone read-only viewer the operator runs themselves — the plugin never spawns a process. The `anagenesis` preset row may also write $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/anagenesis/ on hosts that still discover presets as directories, and removes exactly the files it created when unloaded.
permissions.subprocess: none — no shell, no network, no model calls

disclosure.retention: local-only journal under $DSH_HOME/anagenesis; memory deletion is explicit via ana_forget/ana_expire and is itself journaled. Compaction appends archive segments and by default keeps every seq revertible; the optional retainEvents policy (default 0 = off) may prune whole archive segments, and any such loss is recorded in journal/pruned.json and reported by ana_audit view=status

scripts._comment:test:plugin: DSH_PROFILE_DIR= = 测试隔离铁律：本套件跑在 DSH 宿主里时环境**天然带着** DSH_PROFILE_DIR（指向真实 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop），而多数用例只隔离了 HOME —— 于是它们会去写**真实** profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（2026-10-10 故障：测试 relayDir 被写进真 profile，面板连到假配置、验证码/公告全 502）。这里显式清空，让 profile 解析回落到各用例自己的假 HOME。 DSH_RELAY_BUNDLED_RUNTIME=/nonexistent = 强制走 npx 兜底分支（否则本机跑过 npm pack 后 packages/dsh-remote-web/runtime 存在，用例会改成走本地拷贝）。DSH_RELAY_SKIP_SERVICE=1 = 测试隔离：插件加载时不做真实系统操作（npx 补装 / launchctl / 重启 harness）；需要真实分支的用例自行 unset（见 account-switch / runtime-provision / harness-restart 用例注释）。DSH_RELAY_DEFAULT_API= 死端口：用例拆掉临时目录后，仍在飞的后台请求（装机上报重试等）会读到空配置并回落「默认云端地址」—— 指到本地死端口才不会打生产。
scripts.test:plugin: DSH_PROFILE_DIR= DSH_REMOTE_TELEMETRY=0 DSH_RELAY_SKIP_SERVICE=1 DSH_RELAY_DEFAULT_API=http://127.0.0.1:1 DSH_RELAY_BUNDLED_RUNTIME=/nonexistent-dsh-bundled NODE_OPTIONS="--require $PWD/scripts/test-net-guard.cjs ${NODE_OPTIONS:-}" node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/dsh-remote-web/test/*.test.mjs
scripts._comment:test:bridge: ⚠️ 必须 --test-concurrency=1（与 test:plugin 对齐）：tunnel-auth 有一条「bridge 5 秒内必须重连」的硬期限，并行跑时新增用例抢 CPU 会把它撞破 → 偶发假红（实测单独跑 2/2 通过、并发跑偶发 0/2）。假红比慢更贵。

manifest.//exports[typert]: 官方 Typert 自动发现入口：@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-loader 启动装配时读 exports["./typert"]，导入它并校验 mod.TYPERT（package 必须严格等于包名、face 必须是 'host'），然后 ctx.typert.register(manifest)。生产可用的 dsh-mcp-panel 就走这条。缺了它就只能靠插件自己手工注册 —— 真机上出现过「$mount 报成功但命名空间始终不出现」，所以这条是主路径。
manifest.//files: 只发布运行源码、配置、两份自带 skill（工作流配置、生成操作手册）、README 和许可证。本地资料、开发记录、测试与开发脚本不入包。
manifest.author: 锦瑟 <https://github.com/achenjins>
manifest.//peerDependencies: 只声明 peer，**绝不写进 dependencies**：DSH 的 dsh-app-boot 对 link 进来的插件做 peer 感知的解析拦截（routeLinked + readPeerNames）—— 只要这里点名的包，导入就会被路由到**运行时自己那一份**，从而保证 `defineTool` / `schemastery` / `TypertRemoteService extends Service` 的模块身份与宿主一致。写进 dependencies 会让 pnpm 真装一份物理副本，反而可能变成两份实例。范围故意放宽（`>=0.1.0-0 <0.4.0`）以覆盖 0.1.x / 0.2.x 两条线，避免版本不匹配导致插件被跳过加载。
manifest.//scripts: **故意没有 prepare / postinstall**。本插件是手写 ESM、零构建步骤，所以从 git 安装时不需要任何构建脚本 —— 用户因此**不必**做 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 授权（那条授权等于允许本包在安装时于本机执行代码）。一旦这里加上 prepare/postinstall，那个坎就会立刻出现。
manifest.//test: 测试入口走 tools/run-tests.mjs：自己列出测试文件再交给 node --test，因为 `--test` 的 glob 展开要 Node 21+，而 engines 声明支持 Node 20。
manifest.//concurrency: 测试**必须串行**跑（`--test-concurrency=1`）：默认并行时每个测试文件各起 HTTP server，机器一忙定时器被饿死，定时器相关的断言会间歇假红 —— 实测同一份代码出现过「1 红 / 6 红 / 全绿」三种结果。验收门要的是确定性。

manifest.name: dsh-pet
manifest.description: 基于 dsh-pet 0.3.8 的互动碎碎念版：每 30 秒识屏，用视觉模型在宠物头顶随口吐槽；新增人设导入。
_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）
icon —— 插件图标（DSH 插件管理页显示）：相对 package.json 的图片路径，只认 svg/png/jpg/jpeg/webp，≤256 KiB，realpath 后必须留在包目录内；读取方是 dsh-app-boot 的 iconOf，会内联成 base64 data URL 塞进 meta.icon
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 对官方 DSH 完整版本逐项声明 compatible/incompatible/unknown；只写宽泛范围不算证据，商城最新三版至少需要一个 compatible
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/webm 播放资源（VP9-alpha，浏览器 Chrome/Edge/Firefox 与桌面模式共用）；Safari/HEVC 兼容由仓库流水线支持、fork 定制，不随包发布；assets/preview 的 GIF 仅 README 展示、不入包）
scripts.encode:webm —— 转码管线（step03 母版 → assets/webm 640×360 VP9-alpha）
scripts.build —— 构建完整产物 + files 收敛（node scripts/prepare.js）。克隆后手动跑一次；npm publish / npm pack 由 prepack 自动调用

scripts.prepack —— 发布前链：build（构建）→ typecheck/lint/format → prepack-check（素材健康检查）→ check:openapi。构建只挂这里：npm 11 会把 prepare 判为未批准的安装脚本，而 scripts/prepare.js 不随包发布（files 白名单只留 ensure-electron.mjs），用户一旦按提示批准就必然 ENOENT 失败
bin.dsh-pet-standalone —— 独立模式 CLI（构建产物 lib/standalone.js）：不打开 DSH 直接跑桌宠，把插件的宿主半边跑在伪 ctx 上；tsdown 的第二个入口负责构建，源码见 src/standalone/
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
engines —— Node.js 兼容下限（由运行依赖 @electron/get@5.1.0 的 engines 决定）

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && node scripts/prepack-check.js && npm run check:openapi

manifest.name: @q253595422/dsh-imagegen-video
manifest.description: AI image AND video generation plugin for the dsh web GUI, with a complete video pipeline alongside the image pipeline. Images: text-to-image and image-to-image through configurable provider channels (gpt-image-2 / grok-imagine-image / nanobanana series / seedream-5.0-pro / dall-e-3, with native xAI Grok Imagine, Google Nano Banana and ByteDance Seedream request shaping), per-channel model catalogs, a three-column studio beside the native conversation, an infinite canvas with node-graph workflows (annotation boxes with attached prompt cards, local background removal, AI layer split, per-node model choice, file nodes with any-file upload, and a canvas skill system covering skill-driven next steps on every node: text polish, image description, content extraction, and long-running headless-agent pipelines such as image-to-editable-ppt, with a local skill library that installs and removes skills from URLs or uploaded archives), an ecommerce product-set mode and a prompt template library. Video: text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes with per-channel video model catalogs, an async submit/poll/download pipeline, a clip history merged into the sidebar, favorited clips in the asset library, host-side Agent video tools, video nodes on the infinite canvas with the same controls as image nodes, a storyboard node whose shot list runs one clip per shot into ordinary video nodes (independent shots or each shot starting from the previous shot's last frame; any finished clip can also turn its tail frame into a ready-to-run frame node), clip stitching of two or more canvas video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg in canvas reading order, and a graph-level workflow runner that walks a whole connected chain in dependency order. A director step runs before every render, decomposing a one-line request into shots, motion, camera work, duration and style, and the plan it produces is what the provider is sent (duration and frame may only narrow, never widen); the plan is previewable without rendering, echoed on the task and stored in the clip history.

manifest.name: dsh-vibe-math
manifest.description: Multi-agent mathematical problem-solving & verification frameworks for DeepSeek Harness — FOUR agent presets in one install: vibe-math-v2 (probability-driven, classic: qs.json + Propos knowledge base + explorer→solver→review/debate verdict), vibe-math-v3 (THIRD-generation, classic: paper-style Markdown knowledge base with Problems/Progress/Propos/Methods/Verified + planner-agent scheduling that decides the next N actions + universal theory/method invention library + agents write their own Markdown directly via a per-file write lock), and vibe-math-v4 (FOURTH-generation: persistent self-organizing resident subagents that message & meet to decide all tasks, verify only by unanimous consensus, /compact at a context threshold, and stop only when all agree the problem is solved), and vibe-math-v5 (FIFTH-generation research institute: an academician as the organizational centre who decomposes and ASSIGNS work and chairs meetings; permanent researchers who hold the vote and may hire/fire their own temp workers; temp workers with no vote; a group chat and meetings; a durable per-recipient mailbox; a compare-and-set task DAG; and a boolean m-vote consensus rule where an object enters Verified/ only when at least m voting members agree AND every one of them returns exactly 1 or exactly 0). Installing this bundle auto-installs all four presets (v1 was removed at v2.0.0). Each preset also writes a FINAL PAPER by default when its run concludes — and does so BEFORE the run is marked complete: on v4/v5 the team co-authors its parts, merges them, cross-reviews, and the editor named by paperEditor finalises; the output is Paper/<run or institute id>/{paper.md,paper.tex,paper.pdf when a LaTeX engine is detected,paper.meta.json,paper.log.md} (params finalPaper/paperFormat/paperLanguage/paperCompilePdf/paperLatexCommand, plus paperEditor on v4/v5; see docs/final-paper.md).

dsh.compatNote: v2.8.5 补丁版：修 Lean 形式化通道（此前默认无法编译）、TeX 引擎发现与若干提示词问题，并新增一个纯增量的工作经验反馈库。① Lean：注入的搜索根旗标改用 Lean 4 的 -R（此前用 Lean 3 的 --search-path，编译器在参数解析阶段即以 rc=1 失败、文件从未被读取）——真机实测最小证明编译通过、归档到 Verified/Lean/，并被另一名成员复用。② TeX：「装了但不在 PATH」的引擎现在能在**有界**的文档化候选根里找到（仍只查文档化位置、不扫全盘、绝不自动安装、绝不写工作区之外；未检测到时 triedPaths 具名列出实际探测过的路径）。③ 提示词：缺引擎不再要求成员「向用户询问」而改为「如实上报所办」，LaTeX 指引标注适用范围，「回执」概念首次出现处补背景，空引擎列表改为「可用引擎 无」，面向成员的回执标题改为【研究所提示】，面向代理文本不再含盘符字面量。④ 新增 v5 工具 vibe_v5_feedback 与参数 feedback（默认 on）：self/team 路由自己调整即可、interpersonal 需评估＋事后回填；off 时不注入提示词且每次写入具名拒绝。⑤ 安装/升级：dsh plugin 需要一个可用的 pnpm；安装与升级请给显式版本（dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-vibe-math@2.8.5）——不带版本可能装到旧版。参数名与默认值、数据格式与目录结构均未变；DSH 支撑窗口不变；无需迁移。 | PHASE 6（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2）：0.2.1 移除了 subagents.start()/startContinuable() 并新增 startActivation()；vmu 的默认成员回合交付（deliverMode=subagents）已改为优先走 startActivation（delivery:'caller'），旧的两个动词保留为回退以维持 0.1.2+ 支撑窗口。其余宿主面（tools.register / systemPrompt / subprocess / agents / sendMessage / interrupt / listChildren / 钩子）经运行时服务目录核对未变。

meta.title: 远程访问入口（限网段）
meta.description: 把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），适配 DSH 0.2.1+：只监听网段内的本机地址，网段外一律拒绝；可复制带票网址，也可设数字密码直接访问；自动跟随 0.2.1 的系统分配端口与 HTTPS。配置**只**存在每个 Windows 用户自己的 `$DSH_HOME/remote-access-config.json` 里 —— 插件不读也不写共享 profile，多个用户共用一份 profile 时各用各的端口（端口被占用会自动换一个空闲端口并记住），不再互相抢。手机端可选「手机布局」（横竖屏自适应），回车是换行、只有点「发送」才发送；还会缓存静态大资源（壁纸这类）—— 上游没给缓存头的由本插件补上新鲜期与弱校验器，手机重复打开不再每次重传（正文一个字节都不落宿主盘）。外观与字号可存进本插件配置并只投影到远程页面，不写电脑的设置；0.2.1 起工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量跟随电脑设置。配套安卓 App 退到后台后，模型提问（而电脑上 DSH 窗口不可见）会弹状态栏通知。

_comment: 插件的真实包在 src/：那里才有 lib/（宿主半侧 + 浏览器半侧构建产物）、assets/（106 个 webm）和 cordis.patch.yml。
为什么根目录也声明 dsh.bundle —— 一批目录/工具只把『仓库根』当成安装目标，会生成
dsh plugin add github:12we21/cute-fat-fish-pet
（dshbase 的 gen-catalog.py、bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace、ukinch605/awesome-dsh-hub 的收录条件、
以及 dshfind 的 is_plugin 判定都是这个口径）。根清单没有 dsh.bundle 时，这条命令装不上任何东西，
仓库也会被判成「不是插件」。子目录指向（#path:/src）依然有效，两种装法并存。
main / exports 一律指向 src/ —— src/lib/index.js 里 PACKAGE_ROOT = resolve(new URL('..', import.meta.url))
是模块相对解析，所以无论从仓库根装还是从 src/ 装，assets/ 都能找到。
本清单不参与 Electron / NSIS 打包；打包入口是下面的 scripts（node build/build.mjs 等）。

_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/inject/apply）

lib/cost-projection.js —— costUsage 会话投影（会话累计 + 每轮金额 + 消息归属）
exports['./client'] —— 浏览器半侧入口，DSH 模块系统按它提供 /plugins/dsh-whale-girl-pet/client.js
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，patch 文件是 cordis.patch.yml（安装后自动进层栈）
dsh.client —— 声明浏览器半侧的注入依赖和平台（web）
files —— npm publish 只发这些目录/文件（assets/thumb 播放资源；README.en.md 英文说明）
test/ —— 单测，不发布
peerDependencies —— 运行时由宿主（DSH）提供的模块，本包不打包它们
manifest.author: yanzwzz
_comment_peers: 本包不 import 任何 @deepseek-ai/* 包（宿主侧只用 node 内建 + zod，浏览器侧只 require react），
这些 peer 是'声明式'的：说明本插件绑定的是哪一版 DSH 的服务与槽位契约。
范围必须点名当前 alpha 线：按 semver 的预发布规则，只有范围里存在与目标版本同 patch 的
预发布比较器时，预发布版本才算满足。所以 '^0.1.0-rc.6' 不满足 0.1.6-alpha.2（pnpm 会提示

manifest.name: @restregular/dsh-powerup
manifest.description: Power-Up — small, opt-in upgrades for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a right-click action menu to the Trajectory ledger, an optional stop reason in the session header's background jobs panel (appended to the injected completion notice), and an install control for third-party plugins from the Plugins page: read versions from the configured registries, install the version in the input through the Add plugin path (removing the old copy first), mark restart-needed installs, hand Power-Up's own install to the background, and optionally restart DSH. One-click install skips the enable and restart questions and can apply those actions automatically with configurable defaults. · 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供小型增强：在轨迹页面右键记录即可复制、引用、查看详情或从该记录 Fork；在会话顶部的后台任务面板手动停止任务时可填写停止原因，原因会附加到任务结束后的会话提示；并在插件页为第三方已安装插件提供安装按钮，从安装源读取版本，按输入框中的版本沿用「添加插件」流程安装（先卸载旧版），支持待重启标记、Power-Up 自身后台安装与可选重启；安装面板提供「一键安装」，按输入框版本安装并跳过启用/重启询问，默认自动启用并重启，可在 Power-Up 页面调整默认行为。
